MX2025001753.title: INTELLIGENT AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM FOR INDUSTRIAL INTERNET-BASED VISUAL INSPECTION OF EDGE THINGS AND METHOD FOR ONLINE MONITORING CHARACTERISTICS OF MANUFACTURING PRODUCTS AND HIGH-VOLUME ASSEMBLY USING ROBOTICS AND VERIFICATION OF PROCESS VARIABLES
MX2025001753.abstract: The invention relates to smart manufacturing and industry 4.0, specifically in systems based on the Internet of Things (IIoT-Edge), which integrate local computer, multi-protocol connectivity, real-time storage and processing for decision-making. It is applied in manufacturing lines operating 24/7, using artificial vision, sensors and collaborative robotics for quick and autonomous inspections, minimizing cloud dependency. The proposed system allows autonomous visual inspection, guaranteeing operational continuity in the event of interruptions and optimising data transmission. In addition, it introduces a method for online monitoring of high-volume products by means of robotics and control of process variables.
MX2025001753.assignee: CONSEJO NAC DE CIENCIA Y TECNOLOGIA [MX]

US12710768.title: Edge hardware online model learning and range estimation for autonomous aimpoint determination
US12710768.abstract: [0000]    A seeker configured to generate an aimpoint, wherein the seeker captures image frames associated with a forward-looking perspective of the platform that potentially contain a target and is configured to apply a first method of image processing to the image frames, the first method of image processing not requiring the use of a target model, to finalize a pixel area that matches characteristics associated with the target, to generate at least one track point corresponding to a distinctive portion of the target, and to generate an aimpoint associated with the target. While iteratively applying the first method, the seeker may also store the at least one image frame that matches characteristics associated with the target, creating a reference image frame containing the target; determine at least one track point on the target; search for and update the track points in a subsequent image frame; and search for new track points in the subsequent image frame, creating an updated target model. A second method of image processing may then be applied to subsequent image frames, the second method of image processing comprising using the target model to track the target and updating the aimpoint.
US12710768.assignee: BAE SYS INF & ELECT SYS INTEG [US]

CN122592887.title: Edge side linkage control method and system for electric power autonomous operation
CN122592887.abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an edge-side linkage control method and system for electric power autonomous operation, and the method comprises the steps: solving calculation overload caused by the limitation of edge-side calculation resources through employing a perception-calculation-compensation feedback loop based on an edge-side small model and a behavior verification extrapolation mechanism, the edge side linkage control method for the power autonomous operation aims at solving the problems of calculation overload, execution logic misalignment and phase lag caused by resource limitation and communication disturbance of an existing power edge side, and solves the problems that the existing power edge side generates calculation overload, execution logic misalignment and phase lag under the conditions of resource limitation and communication disturbance. And the deterministic evolution of the physical control loop is realized.

CN122597953.title: Edge vision autonomous system and method based on operation of ultra-lightweight memory security Agent
CN122597953.abstract: The invention relates to an edge vision autonomous system and method based on ultra-lightweight memory security Agent operation, and belongs to the field of edge vision autonomous systems, the system comprises: an end side, which comprises a camera module, a sensor array and an actuator, the camera module is used for original image acquisition, and the actuator is used for executing a decision result of an Agent; the edge side is deployed on an edge computing node with limited resources and is implemented by adopting a memory security compiling language when the ultra-lightweight memory security Agent runs; and the cloud layer is used for continuously optimizing the model.
CN122597953.assignee: ZHEJIANG ZHONGNENG SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

CN122549484.title: Power distribution network edge multi-agent autonomous cooperative control method
CN122549484.abstract: The invention discloses a power distribution network edge multi-agent autonomous cooperative control method, in order to solve the problems of high response delay and poor interoperability of heterogeneous equipment of a traditional centralized architecture, the method comprises the following steps: deploying a lightweight large language model at an edge equipment node, and constructing a semantic primitive communication layer containing an intention-parameter-constraint triple; when a trigger event occurs, the source device agent broadcasts a semantic primitive message; the receiver agent analyzes the message through the local model under the security hard constraint and calculates and adjusts the quoted price; the source equipment intelligent agent generates candidate adjustment schemes through multiple rounds of bidding negotiation; and issuing and executing after the forced verification of the independent security verification module is passed. According to the method, the response delay is reduced to a millisecond level, semantic intercommunication and plug-and-play of heterogeneous equipment are realized, the big language model decision illusion risk is effectively controlled through dual protection of model layer security embedding and decision layer independent verification, and the method is suitable for a power distribution network edge real-time control scene with high-proportion distributed energy access.

CN122493348.title: Cloud-edge collaborative agent autonomous decision driving method
CN122493348.abstract: The invention provides a cloud-edge collaborative agent autonomous decision driving method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring a plurality of paths of sensing video streams representing an agent working environment, executing multi-dimensional feature extraction and real-time behavior feature capture, and generating edge situation sensing metadata containing behavior abnormal dimensions; uploading the metadata to an agent management service platform, calling a local expert knowledge base to execute strategy optimization processing, and determining cloud enhancement logic with a high-dimensional semantic guidance attribute; and performing cross-level semantic alignment processing on the edge situation awareness metadata and the cloud enhancement logic, constructing an alignment constraint vector, performing driving load fusion calculation, and determining an agent autonomous decision driving instruction. Through feature alignment and enhancement of cloud edge cooperation, the technical defects that in a traditional scheme, edge decision-making lacks global logic guidance, and cloud decision-making response is lagged are overcome, and the autonomous decision-making adaptability of an intelligent agent in a complex working environment is improved.
CN122493348.assignee: HEBEI XIONGAN JIABAN INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING TECH CO LTD

KR20260117347.title: Method and System for Controlling Edge Area Navigation of Autonomous Mobile Robot
KR20260117347.abstract: 본 발명은 자율이동로봇의 엣지 주행에 대한 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 자율이동로봇에 탑재된 센서를 이용하여 주변 환경 정보를 획득하고, 획득된 환경 정보를 기반으로 벽 또는 물체의 가장자리 또는 엣지 영역을 인식하며, 인식된 엣지 영역을 기반으로 엣지 주행 경로를 생성하고, 생성된 엣지 주행 경로를 따라 자율이동로봇을 제어하는 단계를 포함한다.  본 발명은 실시간 센서 데이터를 기반으로 엣지 영역을 인식하고, 동적 장애물 회피 알고리즘을 통해 안전한 엣지 주행 경로를 생성하며, 경로 수정 알고리즘을 통해 예상치 못한 환경 변화에 유연하게 대응함으로써 경로 추적, 장애물 회피, 효율적 영역 커버리지 기능을 제공하며, 다양한 환경에서 안정적 자율주행을 구현한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 자율이동로봇은 복잡하고 동적인 환경에서도 안정적이고 효율적인 엣지 주행을 수행하고, 주행 누락을 방지하고, 각 환경에 대한 주행 전략을 효과적으로 탐색할 수 있다.

US20260307250.title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR 3D SCENE GRAPH-BASED SPATIAL EXPLORATION FOR ROBOT
US20260307250.abstract: [0000]    A method and an apparatus for 3D scene graph-based spatial exploration for a robot. The method is performed by a computing device including a processor and a memory, and includes receiving user query data including a work request for the robot, identifying a location of the robot and generating a map based on sensor information collected by the robot, generating a 3D scene graph based on the identified location of the robot and the generated map, and inferring the exploration space for the robot to travel based on the user query data, the map, and the 3D scene graph.

EP4814664.title: HAPTISCHE VERFOLGUNG: RÄUMLICHE HAPTIK UNTER VERWENDUNG EINES GRAPHBASIERTEN SYSTEMS
EP4814664.abstract: Some embodiments of a method may include: receiving a bitstream associated with a haptic signal; decoding the bitstream, wherein the decoded bitstream comprises properties used to support haptic spatialization and further comprises a list of haptic mediums at a file level, a list of haptic sources at the file level, and a list of haptic listeners at the file level; and generating the haptic signal using the decoded bitstream.
claims:
1. A method comprising: receiving a bitstream associated with a haptic signal;
decoding the bitstream,
wherein the decoded bitstream comprises properties used to support haptic spatialization and further comprises a list of haptic mediums at a file level, a list of haptic sources at the file level, and a list of haptic listeners at the file level; and
generating the haptic signal using the decoded bitstream. 2. The method of claim 1, wherein the list of haptic mediums comprises medium property information for at least one of: haptic modalities supporting propagation of the haptic signal, thermal conductivity, vibrotactile mediation, and one or more propagation functions. 3. The method of claim 2, wherein at least one of the one or more propagation functions comprises information indicating a haptic modality. 4. The method of claim 2, wherein at least one of the one or more propagation functions comprises information indicating a Uniform Resource Name (URN) associated with the respective propagation function. 5. The method of claim 2, wherein at least one of the one or more propagation functions comprises information indicating a custom function. 6. The method of any one of claims 1-5, wherein the list of haptic mediums comprises information indicating supported haptic modalities, and
wherein at least one of the supported haptic modalities is from a group consisting of: pressure, acceleration, velocity, position, temperature, vibration, water, wind, force, and electrotactile. 7. The method of any one of claims 1-6, wherein the list of haptic sources comprises information indicating at least one haptic media associated with the respective haptic source. 8. The method of any one of claims 1-7, wherein the list of haptic listeners comprises information indicating at least one haptic modality supported by the respective haptic listener. 9. The method of any one of claims 1-8, wherein the decoded bitstream further comprises information linking one or more nodes to at least one element of at least one list of the list of haptic mediums, the list of haptic sources, and the list of haptic listeners. 10. The method of any one of claims 1-9, wherein the decoded bitstream further comprises a list of haptic mediums at a node level, a list of haptic sources at the node level, and a list of haptic listeners at the node level. 11. The method of claim 10, wherein the node level comprises information indicating one or more links to one or more objects of an immersive environment. 12. The method of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the decoded bitstream further comprises information linking one or more objects of an immersive scene to at least one element of at least one list of the list of haptic mediums, the list of haptic sources, and the list of haptic listeners. 13. The method of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the file level is a gITF file level. 14. The method of any one of claims 1-13, wherein the decoded bitstream complies with an MPEG-based standard. 15. An apparatus comprising: a processor; and
a memory storing instructions operative, when executed by the processor, to cause the apparatus to perform the method of any one of claims 1 through 14.

KR20260142266.title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CONSTRUCTING A SPATIAL KNOWLEDGE GRAPH CONSIDERING SPATIAL TOPOLOGICAL STRUCTURE
KR20260142266.abstract: 공간적 위상구조를 고려한 공간 지식 그래프 구축 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 공간적 위상구조를 고려한 공간 지식 그래프 구축 방법은, (a) 대상 공간에 존재하는 도로 정보를 반영하도록 미리 구축된 주소 데이터를 획득하는 단계, (b) 상기 주소 데이터에 포함된 도로구간에 대한 정보 및 상기 도로구간에서 건물 또는 시설물의 출입구까지의 접근 경로에 대한 정보 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 신규 교점을 생성하는 단계 및 (c) 상기 도로구간의 시작점, 끝점, 상기 출입구의 위치 및 상기 신규 교점을 노드(Node)로 하고, 상기 노드 사이의 도로 연결 관계를 엣지(Edge)로 하는 공간 지식 그래프를 생성하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

CN122595857.title: Bearing life prediction method and system based on heterogeneous graph and spatial-temporal feature fusion
CN122595857.abstract: The invention provides a bearing life prediction method and system based on heterogeneous graph and spatio-temporal feature fusion. The method comprises the steps that vibration signals of a whole life cycle of a rolling bearing are collected, and time domain features and frequency domain features are extracted to serve as original input; constructing a heterogeneous graph data structure composed of a plurality of node types and edge connection types on a heterogeneous graph convolution branch, and extracting spatial association of degradation features by using different types of graph convolution networks; a plurality of residual blocks with different expansion coefficients are introduced into the time convolution branch to learn time sequence characteristics in the degradation process layer by layer; the expression ability of the features is enhanced through a node attention mechanism and a self-attention mechanism, the feature weight is dynamically adjusted by using a gating mechanism to realize spatio-temporal feature fusion, and a prediction result of the remaining service life of the rolling bearing is obtained through a full connection layer. Benefited from introduction of a heterogeneous graph data structure and a space-time parallel model framework, the prediction model provided by the invention is greatly improved in prediction precision and stability.

CN122574489.title: Medical image classification method and system based on graph fusion spatial state model
CN122574489.abstract: The invention discloses a medical image classification method and system based on a graph fusion spatial state model, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing and artificial intelligence deep learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a multi-modal medical image, and carrying out the preprocessing of the multi-modal medical image; inputting the preprocessed multi-modal medical image into an overlapped stem embedding layer, and generating an initial feature through a convolution embedding operation; inputting the initial features into a hierarchical feature extraction network for hierarchical feature extraction; the hierarchical feature extraction network comprises a plurality of MambaGNN blocks, every two adjacent MambaGNN blocks are connected through a down-sampling layer, and final enhanced features are output by the last layer of MambaGNN block; and inputting the final enhanced features into the classification head, and outputting a category probability prediction result corresponding to the multi-modal medical image. According to the method, the defects of local-global modeling balance, calculation complexity control, topological relation capture and the like in the prior art are overcome.

CN122571474.title: Non-residual knowledge graph construction and text travel fusion decision-making method based on spatial correlation analysis
CN122571474.abstract: The invention provides a non-abandoned knowledge graph construction and tourist travel fusion decision-making method based on spatial correlation analysis, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: 1, collecting the attribute data and spatial position data of non-abandoned items and tourist attractions, and collecting basic geographic information data at the same time, cleaning, standardizing and geocoding the attribute data, the spatial position data and the basic geographic information data; 2, performing spatial statistical analysis on the processed spatial position data, respectively calculating the spatial distribution kernel density of a non-missing item point set and a scenic spot point set, generating a corresponding thermodynamic diagram, and calculating a double-variant spatial autocorrelation index between a non-missing item and a scenic spot; step 3, constructing a spatial enhanced non-abandoned knowledge graph based on the spatial distribution kernel density of the non-abandoned items and the tourist attractions and the bivariate spatial autocorrelation index; and step 4, based on the spatial enhanced non-abandoned knowledge graph, providing a text travel fusion decision support application which specifically comprises at least one of a fusion visual display module, an intelligent query recommendation module, a regional development potential evaluation module and a theme travel route planning module.

CN122548184.title: Night vitality evaluation method coupling spatial clustering and multi-scale graph convolution
CN122548184.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of urban night vitality evaluation, and discloses a night vitality evaluation method coupling spatial clustering and multi-scale graph convolution, which comprises the following steps: constructing a township-level spatial structure skeleton by using a triangulation network, and embedding a pre-constructed urban environment index set into the township-level spatial structure skeleton in a node attribute form, a city map network is obtained; carrying out coupling space clustering on the urban environment index set by utilizing a space function clustering method, and carrying out multi-scale neighborhood aggregation setting in combination with a preset neighborhood mapping rule to obtain a neighborhood scale determination result; and constructing a multi-scale image convolutional neural network model according to a neighborhood scale determination result, and inputting the city image network into the multi-scale image convolutional neural network model for city night vitality evaluation to obtain a city night vitality prediction value. The urban night vitality evaluation method effectively overcomes the limitation that the existing urban night vitality evaluation method neglects the high-order correlation between space units and the spatial heterogeneity of environmental elements.

CN122526540.title: GeoSOT spatial graph data dynamic updating system and method
CN122526540.abstract: The invention relates to airspace graph updating, in particular to a GeoSOT airspace graph data dynamic updating system and method, a space-time reference layer takes a multi-source grid data stream output by a skid-mounted unit as input, and a GeoSOT unified space-time engine is utilized to output a unified space-time identifier; the dynamic updating engine layer is used for solving an updating conflict problem during multi-event concurrence by adopting a priority scheduling algorithm based on multi-event collaborative triggering on the basis of unified space-time identification, optimizing a local updating range by adopting a self-adaptive neighborhood radius algorithm based on event influence intensity, establishing a correlation model of a version and a traffic light state, and updating the traffic light state according to the correlation model; the accurate traceability of the traffic light state is supported, the AI prediction result is used as the input of event triggering update, and the closed-loop control of'prediction-update-feedback 'is realized; the method can effectively overcome the defects that multi-source data access standardization is insufficient, an event triggering mechanism is single, version management and traffic light state evolution are disjointed, AI prediction and dynamic updating do not form a closed loop, and the local updating range is fixed.
CN122526540.assignee: BEIDOU FUXI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN122508242.title: Winter wheat yield prediction method based on graph attention network and multi-source spatial-temporal characteristic driving
CN122508242.abstract: The invention discloses a winter wheat yield prediction method based on a graph attention network and multi-source spatial-temporal characteristic driving. The winter wheat yield prediction method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring multi-source data in a growth period of winter wheat in a target area and preprocessing the multi-source data; s2, performing spatial aggregation on the target preprocessing data to generate a target region feature vector; s3, performing time sequence feature extraction and fusion processing on the target area feature vectors to construct target graph node features; obtaining relational data of the target area and adjacent areas thereof, and processing to construct target edge features; s4, performing inter-node information transmission and neighborhood attention aggregation by adopting the trained graph attention network model to obtain final representation of target graph nodes; and S5, a decision generator is adopted to perform prediction according to the final representation of the target graph nodes, and a target prediction result for representing the winter wheat yield is obtained. According to the method, accurate prediction and spatial heterogeneity characterization of the regional winter wheat yield are realized, and technical support is provided for regional grain yield monitoring and agricultural production evaluation.
CN122508242.assignee: HENAN UNIV OF ECONOMICS AND LAW

CN122474152.title: Spatial omics spatial domain identification method and system based on graph structure self-learning
CN122474152.abstract: The invention discloses a spatial omics spatial domain identification method and system based on graph structure self-learning, and belongs to the technical field of bioinformatics, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining spatial omics data of a to-be-identified target tissue; taking a graph neural network model for downstream execution of spatial domain recognition as a target model, extracting a pseudo code of the target model, performing matching retrieval on the pseudo code and a model pseudo code in a historical knowledge base, obtaining a reference graph construction code, and generating an initial graph construction code population through large language model fine tuning; based on spatial omics data, running each initial graph construction code to generate a graph structure, inputting each graph structure into a target model and performing double-index fitness evaluation, iteratively optimizing graph construction logic by adopting a semantic mutation mechanism of a large language model to obtain an optimal graph construction code and generate a graph structure, and finally constructing the target model. And inputting the target model to execute spatial domain clustering and region division to obtain a spatial domain identification result. According to the invention, the accuracy, efficiency and interpretability of spatial domain identification can be improved.

CN122454416.title: Urban multi-source spatial data fusion method and system based on graph comparison
CN122454416.abstract: The invention provides a city multi-source spatial data fusion method and system based on graph comparison, and relates to the technical field of data fusion, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining city multi-source spatial data of a to-be-processed region, and carrying out the preprocessing of the city multi-source spatial data; s2, extracting the preprocessed urban multi-source spatial data to obtain a corresponding point-shaped graph data set, a plane-shaped graph data set and a linear graph data set; s3, performing fusion and conflict judgment on the point-shaped graph data set, the plane-shaped graph data set and the linear graph data set to generate a corresponding fusion result; according to the method, high-quality fusion of multi-source data is realized, reliable data support is provided for urban digital construction and intelligent management, and the method has remarkable technical advantages and practical application value.

CN122455158.title: Chlorophyll forecasting method based on spatial heterogeneous perception graph time sequence adversarial network
CN122455158.abstract: The invention discloses a chlorophyll a forecasting method based on a spatial heterogeneous perceptual graph time sequence adversarial network, relates to the technical field of chlorophyll a forecasting, and is used for solving the problems of strong subjectivity, not fine enough partition boundary and relatively large statistical characteristic difference in a region when artificial partition is used for coping with spatial heterogeneity. According to the method, reconstructed daily scale chlorophyll a concentration remote sensing data and numerical simulation sea surface temperature data SST are used as input, and a chlorophyll a time evolution behavior-based spatial heterogeneous partitioning, graph convolutional network GCN spatial coding, time convolutional network TCN time coding and regional discriminator constraint are used for performing spatial heterogeneous partitioning on the basis of chlorophyll a time evolution behaviors. And short-term forecasting of chlorophyll a concentration spatial distribution in several days in the future is realized, so that the characterization capability of the model on the heterogeneous change process of chlorophyll a in a near-shore complex sea area is improved.

CN122453289.title: Multi-target path collaborative optimization method based on spatial-temporal feature enhancement and graph neural network guidance
CN122453289.abstract: The invention provides a multi-target path collaborative optimization method based on spatial-temporal feature enhancement and graph neural network guidance. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a basic data system for supporting path optimization; step 2, generating a node embedding vector capable of guiding path search; 3, reconstructing the relevance of the distribution task in the feature space, and generating a high-quality initial solution set through heuristic guidance; step 4, fine iteration of the distribution scheme is realized through an improved genetic operator; and 5, establishing a quick table look-up mechanism based on time axis discretization preprocessing and state recursion. According to the method, the realistic adaptability and algorithm optimization precision of a path planning scheme are effectively improved, collaborative optimization of distribution efficiency and driving safety is realized, the calculation complexity in a dynamic scene is greatly reduced, a Pareto optimal solution considering multi-target requirements can be generated, the real-time scheduling and decision-making requirements of a complex urban distribution scene are met, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. And the method has good engineering application value.

WO2026152712.title: MOYEN D'APPRENTISSAGE DE GRAPHES EN GRILLES SPATIO-TEMPORELS
WO2026152712.abstract: A computer vision system may receive or generate a graph sequence of an object. The graph sequence includes graphs corresponding to different times stamps. A graph includes nodes and edges connecting the nodes. The system may interpolate extra nodes among adjacent nodes in space and time at multiple orders to enrich the expressiveness of the graph sequence and encode the interpolated graph-structured sequence into a grid-patch representation of the object. For instance, the system may perform spatial interpolation and temporal interpolation on the graph sequence through linear transformations to generate an interpolated graph sequence. The system may assign nodes of the interpolated graph sequence to cells of a grid patch to generate a grid representation of the object. A convolution may be operated upon the grid to predict an action of the object.

receiving a graph sequence of an object, the graph sequence having graphs representing the object at different times stamps, agraph comprising nodes and edges connecting the nodes;
generating a plurality of interpolated nodes based on nodes in the graph sequence;
generating an interpolated graph sequence by adding the plurality of interpolated nodes into the graph sequence;
converting the interpolated graph sequence into a grid representing the object;
performing a convolution operation on the grid; and
predicting an action of the object based on an output of the convolution operation. 2. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the plurality of interpolated nodes comprises:
generating one or more interpolated nodes based on one or more spatial features of the graph sequence; and
generating one or more other interpolated nodes based on one or more temporal features of the graph sequence. 3. The method of claim 2, wherein generating the one or more interpolated nodes comprises:
identifying one or more node pairs in the graph, anode pair comprising two nodes connected with a single edge; and
generating at least one of the one or more interpolated nodes by interpolating the one or more node pairs through a linear transformation. 4. The method of claim 3, wherein generating the one or more interpolated nodes further comprises:
identifying a set of three or more nodes in the graph, the three or more nodes connected through edges as a sequence in the graph; and
generating at least one of the one or more interpolated nodes by interpolating the three or more nodes through a linear transformation. 5. The method of any one of claims 2-4, wherein generating the one or more other interpolated nodes comprises:
identifying one or more node pairs in the graph sequence, anode pair comprising two nodes at two adjacent time stamps; and
generating at least one of the one or more other interpolated nodes by interpolating the one or more node pairs through a linear transformation. 6. The method of claim 5, wherein generating the one or more other interpolated nodes further comprises:
identifying one or more additional node pairs in the graph sequence, an additional node pair comprising a node at a first time stamp and a node at a second time stamp, wherein the first time stamp and the second time stamp are separated by one or more other time stamps; and
generating at least one of the one or more interpolated nodes by interpolating the one or more additional node pairs. 7. The method of any one of claims 1-6, wherein converting the interpolated graph sequence into the grid comprises:
assigning nodes of the interpolated graph sequence to cells of a target grid patch, wherein each node is assigned to a different cell. 8. One or more non-transitory computer-readable media storing instructions executable to perform operations, the operations comprising:

assigning nodes of the interpolated graph sequence to cells of a target grid patch, wherein each node is assigned to a different cell. 17. An apparatus, comprising:

a non-transitory computer-readable memory storing computer program instructions executable by the computer processor to perform operations comprising:

generating a plurality of interpolated nodes based on nodes in the graph sequence,

US20260212114.title: DATA STORAGE CONTROL USING A SPATIAL-SEQUENTIAL GRAPH NETWORK WITH NON-ADJACENT SEQUENTIAL NODE CONNECTIONS
US20260212114.abstract: Techniques are provided for data storage control using a spatial-sequential graph network with non-adjacent sequential node connections. One method comprises obtaining portions of a digital file; determining spatial relationships and sequential relationships associated with the digital file; generating a graph representation of the digital file based on the determined spatial relationships and the determined sequential relationships; encoding the determined spatial relationships and the determined sequential relationships from the graph representation into a spatial-sequential graph network comprised of nodes and edges connecting nodes, wherein two non-adjacent nodes in the spatial-sequential graph network are connected in the spatial-sequential graph network based on one or more distance metrics relating to the two non-adjacent nodes; performing similarity detection for the digital file; and initiating an automated data storage control action based on a result of the similarity detection.

CN122436033.title: Multi-station water quality prediction method based on spatial relationship decomposition and continuous kernel graph convolution
CN122436033.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-site water quality prediction method based on spatial relationship decomposition and continuous kernel graph convolution, and belongs to the crossing field of artificial intelligence technology and environment monitoring technology. According to the method, on the basis of watershed multi-site water quality monitoring data, a static graph reflecting a long-term geographic structure and a dynamic graph representing time-varying water quality interaction are constructed through spatial relationship decomposition (SRD), and multi-dimensional description of spatial dependence is achieved; introducing continuous kernel graph convolution (CKGConv), constructing a continuous kernel function by using pseudo coordinates based on random walk, respectively establishing double-branch spatial convolution models for the static graph and the dynamic graph, and obtaining stable spatial relationship and dynamic propagation characteristics in the drainage basin; an Informer time sequence modeling module is further adopted, long-time dependence in water quality changes is effectively captured through a sparse self-attention mechanism and a sequence down-sampling structure, and efficient spatio-temporal joint prediction is achieved. Through combination of a static-dynamic double-branch structure and continuous kernel convolution, the problems of insufficient spatial dependency expression, unreasonable dynamic graph construction and difficult long sequence modeling in a traditional water quality prediction method are solved, and the precision and stability of multi-station water quality prediction are remarkably improved. The method has the technical advantages of being high in calculation efficiency, high in generalization ability, capable of being suitable for multi-site water quality change prediction in the drainage basin monitoring network and the like, and has good engineering application value.

CN122412392.title: Conflict pattern spot treatment method and device based on spatial database topological graph model
CN122412392.abstract: The invention discloses a conflict pattern spot treatment method and device based on a spatial database topological graph model, and relates to the technical field of spatial databases. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing pattern spot data in a spatial database to obtain a standardized pattern spot data set, and analyzing a spatial relationship among pattern spots in the standardized pattern spot data set to identify conflicting pattern spots; constructing a corresponding spatial database topological graph model; calculating the collaborative treatment intensity between the conflict pattern spots, and dividing the conflict pattern spots into at least one collaborative treatment unit according to the collaborative treatment intensity; for the conflict pattern spots in each collaborative treatment unit, identifying whether a treatment dependency relationship exists between the conflict pattern spots, so as to carry out topological sorting on the collaborative treatment units according to the treatment dependency relationship, and determining a treatment path of each collaborative treatment unit; and generating a conflict pattern spot collaborative treatment scheme corresponding to the spatial database according to the treatment path.

CN122392107.title: Micro-expression recognition method based on hierarchical spatial-temporal feature perception and graph contrast learning
CN122392107.abstract: The invention discloses a micro-expression recognition method based on hierarchical spatial-temporal feature perception and graph contrast learning, and the method comprises the steps: extracting micro-expression data from a micro-expression sample database, and constructing a micro-expression training set and a tag set; constructing and training a multi-level micro-expression recognition model; wherein the multilevel micro-expression recognition model comprises a preprocessing module, a first hierarchical spatial-temporal feature extraction module, a first gating fusion module, a second hierarchical spatial-temporal feature extraction module, a second gating fusion module and a third hierarchical spatial-temporal feature extraction module which are connected in sequence; a third gating fusion module and an integrated classification module; and inputting the micro-expression data to be recognized into the trained multi-level micro-expression recognition model, and obtaining and outputting a recognition result. According to the method, the subtle spatial-temporal dynamic information of the micro-expression can be fully mined, the generalization ability and the recognition precision of the model are improved, and the problems that the existing method is insufficient in extraction of subtle motion features of the micro-expression and easy to over-fit are solved.

CN122366767.title: Geochemical prospecting method based on graph neural network and spatial features
CN122366767.abstract: The invention relates to a geochemical prospecting method based on a graph neural network and spatial features. The geochemical prospecting method realizes geochemical prospecting according to accurately predicted background contents of different chemical elements in different geological environments. Comprising the following steps: carrying out preprocessing and background data separation on original geochemical multi-element data to obtain background region data; constructing a spatial context statistical feature of each sampling point of the geochemical multi-element data according to a preset spatial scale, and fusing the spatial context statistical feature with the original environment feature of the sampling point to generate an enhanced environment feature vector of each sampling point; according to statistical correlation among chemical elements in the background area data, a graph topological structure is constructed by adopting a maximum spanning tree algorithm; and constructing a graph neural network according to the graph topological structure, inputting the enhanced environment feature vector of each sampling point into the graph neural network, outputting to obtain a background content prediction value of each chemical element in each sampling point, and calculating to obtain a mine prediction graph.

CN122366189.title: Spatial constraint verification method, system and equipment based on knowledge graph and medium
CN122366189.abstract: The invention discloses a spatial constraint verification method, system and device based on a knowledge graph and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: segmenting multi-modal data related to urban design specifications, and obtaining a plurality of information blocks; performing information extraction on the standard text and the spatial constraint graphical representation of the information block according to a structured constraint data structure to obtain a structured constraint unit of the information block; performing spatial predicate template matching on the structured constraint unit through the template mapping table, and generating a corresponding spatial predicate instance according to the matched spatial predicate template; according to the structured constraint unit and the spatial predicate instance, constructing a double-layer knowledge graph, and performing spatial constraint verification on the input three-dimensional model data through the double-layer knowledge graph to obtain a verification result; according to the method, unified modeling and cross-modal association reasoning based on specification text and graphical representation rule constraint information can be realized, and the structured management automation degree, compliance examination efficiency and accuracy of specification knowledge in the field of urban design are improved.

CN122346948.title: Urban double-drainage-system automatic modeling method based on graph theory and spatial sorting
CN122346948.abstract: The invention discloses an urban double-drainage-system automatic modeling method based on a graph theory and spatial sorting, and belongs to the technical field of urban flood control and drainage and water conservancy informatization. Comprising the steps of constructing a structured data set containing topology control parameters, traversing row data to perform underground pipe network topology construction, performing road topology reconstruction based on spatial adaptive sorting, automatically stitching a complex topological relation, performing virtual correction and the like. According to the method, automatic conversion from discrete and out-of-order pipe network general survey data to a high-precision double-layer hydraulic model is realized through structured data in combination with a spatial adaptive sorting algorithm.

CN122333272.title: Dynamic graph anomaly detection method and system fusing spatial-temporal feature enhancement and potential structure mining
CN122333272.abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic graph anomaly detection method and system fusing spatial-temporal feature enhancement and potential structure mining, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-detected dynamic graph data flow, and dividing the dynamic graph data flow into a plurality of discrete time snapshots based on a timestamp; based on the node features of the current time snapshot, learning potential association between nodes, and generating a sparse potential graph structure; fusing an original graph structure with the potential graph structure to generate an enhanced graph structure; constructing a vertex-edge transfer matrix, and iteratively executing bidirectional feature propagation and updating from the vertex to the edge and from the edge to the vertex on the enhanced graph structure by using the vertex-edge transfer matrix to obtain updated node features; and inputting the updated node features into an anomaly detection model, calculating the anomaly probability of each node, and outputting a detection result. According to the method, potential association is mined through dynamic graph structure learning, the calculation complexity is reduced by using a vertex-edge interaction mechanism, and the accuracy and robustness of anomaly detection are improved.

CN122283970.title: Undirected probability graph geologic model construction method based on spatial position coding
CN122283970.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of geological engineering, and discloses an undirected probability graph geologic model construction method based on spatial position coding in order to solve the problem that undirected probability graph geologic model parameter learning consumes time and depends on subjective experience to cause errors. The method comprises the following steps: determining a geological modeling range according to known drilling data, dispersing the geological modeling range into a grid structure, and filling corresponding grids with stratum data in the known drilling data according to a soil body type; according to the spatial position relationship between the grid structure and the known drilling data, performing spatial position coding on the unknown grid; according to the spatial position relation between the grid structure and the known drilling data, an initial state is given to the unknown grid to obtain an initial stratum, and an undirected probability graph geologic model is constructed; and based on a spatial position coding result, constructing a data-driven parameter optimization method, and performing parameter learning on the undirected probability graph geologic model to obtain optimal parameters. By adopting the method, the geological modeling precision of the undirected probability graph model is improved.

CN122264901.title: Self-supervised item recommendation heterogeneous graph learning method based on unified spatial spectrum view angle
CN122264901.abstract: The invention discloses a self-supervised article recommendation heterogeneous graph learning method based on a unified spatial-spectral view angle, and the method is a self-supervised article recommendation heterogeneous graph learning framework considering spatial domain and spectral domain information at the same time, and the framework is beneficial to graph representation learning. Specifically, information from local neighbor nodes is aggregated by using a spatial domain encoder, and global structure information is extracted by using a spectrum encoder, so that noise of local aggregation is suppressed. Subsequently, a homeomorphic mapping method is proposed, which can avoid loss of domain specific information while aligning dual-domain characterization. In addition, a spectrum optimization module is provided, and original characterization is effectively optimized by utilizing guidance of fusion characterization generation clustering levels. A large number of experimental results on article recommendation heterogeneous graph data sets in all real world show that the method has remarkable superiority.

CN122266474.title: Spatial multi-omics data integration, alignment and omics inference method based on paired graph contrast learning
CN122266474.abstract: The invention particularly relates to a spatial multi-omics data integration, alignment and omics inference method based on paired graph contrast learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring omics expression counting matrixes and spot space coordinates of a plurality of tissue slices; constructing a slice space diagram based on the spot space coordinates, and preprocessing the omics expression counting matrix to obtain initial features of each group of omics modals; for data of the same omics mode in different tissue slices, a single omics integration module is used for joint learning to obtain a single omics embedded representation; aiming at the single-omics embedding representations of different omics modes in the same tissue slice, carrying out adaptive weighted fusion by utilizing a weighted nearest neighbor algorithm to obtain multi-omics integration representations; according to multi-omics integration characterization of different tissue slices, cross-space alignment is carried out on spots in all the slices by adopting a tagged domain guided truncation iteration nearest point method, cross-batch, cross-omics and cross-slice collaborative integration can be realized, and the accuracy of spatial domain identification and cross-omics inference is improved.

CN122221917.title: Graph variational auto-encoder method for spatial multi-omics cross-modal prediction and interpolation
CN122221917.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of multi-omics cross-modal prediction and interpolation. The invention provides a graph variational auto-encoder method for spatial multi-omics cross-modal prediction and interpolation. According to the embodiment of the invention, specific encoders and decoders are designed for data of different spatial omics, and specific loss functions are introduced for different data characteristics to learn characteristics of different omics data, so that accurate data generation is realized. Two stages are designed, a discriminator is introduced to optimize model parameters, the operation efficiency is very high, and data of other modes can be quickly generated on a trained generator.

CN122201450.title: Spatial transcriptome data interpolation method based on fusion of generative adversarial network and multi-view graph convolutional network
CN122201450.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bioinformatics, in particular to a space transcriptome data interpolation method based on fusion of a generative adversarial network and a multi-view graph convolutional network, and the method comprises the steps: preprocessing single-cell RNA sequencing data and space transcriptome data; obtaining a sequencing data generator by using a deep generative adversarial network; generating a spatial transcriptome data generator; constructing a spatial adjacency graph and a feature adjacency graph based on spatial coordinates of cells in the spatial transcriptome data and a gene expression profile obtained after preliminary interpolation of a spatial transcriptome data generator, and performing spatial and feature information integration through a multi-view graph convolutional network to obtain integrated potential representation; and training and testing the multi-view image convolutional network, the sequencing data generator and the spatial transcriptome data generator to obtain a final gene expression interpolation model. According to the method, high-fidelity full-transcriptome-scale spatial data with consistent space can be generated.

CN122176339.title: Spatial domain identification and regulation analysis method based on hierarchical graph representation learning
CN122176339.abstract: The invention discloses a spatial domain identification and regulation analysis method based on hierarchical graph representation learning, and relates to the technical field of spatial multi-omics data analysis. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring spatial multi-omics data, and constructing an intracellular gene and protein interaction diagram based on biological prior knowledge; after initial node features are extracted by using a graph convolution network, a regulation matrix is learned through a cross-graph matching module, and cross-graph convolution operation is carried out to obtain enhanced features; carrying out weighted fusion by utilizing an attention mechanism to generate intracellular multi-omics joint representation; then constructing an intercellular space and feature proximity graph, and aggregating context information by using a graph attention network to obtain intercellular multi-omics embedding representation; and finally, carrying out training and unsupervised clustering by utilizing graph contrast learning to identify a spatial domain, and aggregating the regulation matrix to extract a specific regulation relation of a specific spatial domain. According to the method, correlation analysis of molecular regulation and control and tissue ecological niche is realized, and biological interpretability is taken into account while fine space structure division is realized.

CN122154493.title: Multi-physics field digital twinning method and system based on spatial selectivity graph Bayesian inference, and medium
CN122154493.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-physics field digital twinning method and system based on spatial selectivity graph Bayesian inference and a medium, mainly relates to the technical field of multi-physics field digital twinning, and is used for solving the problem that in an existing scheme, conflicts exist between calculation efficiency and physical fidelity. Comprising the steps of determining a physical probe range, and obtaining nodes in the physical probe range; based on the predicted temperature field, node predicted temperatures of all nodes in the physical probe range are extracted, and then a mean value is calculated to serve as a final predicted value of the sensor; acquiring the actual observation value of each sensor; calculating a log-likelihood function value and a joint log-posterior probability of the current global operation proposal parameter value based on the actual observation value and the final prediction value; generating a new global operation proposal parameter value based on the current global operation proposal parameter value by adopting a multi-chain parallel MCMC algorithm; and judging whether updating of the global operation proposal parameter value is accepted or not based on the joint logarithmic posterior probability.

EP4752630.title: NEURONALE GRAPHNETZWERKE ZUR AUSNUTZUNG RÄUMLICHER UND SEMANTISCHER BEZIEHUNGEN IN METROLOGIEDATEN
EP4752630.abstract: A method of using a graph neural network to process metrology data of a patterned portion of a substrate patterned using a lithographic apparatus, to generate characterization information characterizing the patterned portion of the substrate. The method comprises obtaining metrology data, defining a graph of a graph neural network, defining feature data for each node of the graph based on the metrology data, and at least once generating, using the graph neural network and for each node, corresponding message data for each node associated with the node and updating, for each node, the feature data for the node based on the corresponding one or more message data, to form updated feature data. The method further comprises generating the characterization information from the updated feature data.

CN122573495.title: Second-hand car price prediction method and device
CN122573495.abstract: The invention provides a second-hand car price prediction method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-source data of a second-hand car, the multi-source data comprising structured data, unstructured text data and image data; determining a first type of features and a second type of features based on the multi-source data; the first type of features comprise at least one of brand, vehicle age, mileage, accident fault grade and appearance damage features; the second type of features comprise at least one of a brand premium price coefficient, a region clustering feature and a vehicle condition attenuation coefficient obtained through calculation based on the first type of features; inputting the first type of features and the second type of features into a hybrid prediction model to obtain a predicted price of the second-hand car; the hybrid prediction model comprises a gradient lifting decision tree model, a deep cross network model and a time sequence prediction model. According to the invention, the second-hand car price prediction accuracy is improved.

CN122354158.title: Refrigerator car peak-valley electricity price cold storage and cold release method based on modular phase change cold storage
CN122354158.abstract: According to the refrigerator car peak-valley electricity price cold storage and cold release method based on modular phase change cold storage, through cooperation of valley electricity cold storage and the cold core module, the cold-chain logistics operation cost is remarkably reduced, and peak-valley electricity price arbitrage is achieved. The cold core module charges cold in a low ebb period, replaces or assists in mechanical refrigeration in a peak period, and can serve as a movable cold source to supplement cold for the refrigeration house, so that the cold energy utilization efficiency is improved. The system adopts a high-performance phase change material and an optimized heat exchange structure, so that the low-temperature stability in the transportation process is effectively guaranteed, and the risk of chain breakage is prevented. The cold core module supports flexible allocation between the refrigerator car and the refrigeration house, and dynamic allocation of the cooling capacity of storage and transportation scenes is achieved. The modular quick-assembly design facilitates quick replacement and maintenance under high-frequency transportation, and the temperature of the compartment is ensured to be constant in cooperation with an intelligent bimodal temperature control system. The material is good in cycling stability, long in service life and free of leakage risk. The whole scheme is outstanding in energy-saving effect, greatly reduces carbon emission, and has the advantages of economy, environmental protection and large-scale application.

CN122288773.title: Second-hand car entrance and exit price interval prediction method based on machine learning
CN122288773.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of second-hand vehicle import and export price interval prediction, in particular to a machine learning-based second-hand vehicle import and export price interval prediction method, which comprises the following steps of: extracting customs declaration detection data to establish a sample library, comparing supply and demand of same-level alternative vehicle types to quantify market competition differences, and tracking multi-stage score fluctuation to generate a vehicle condition dynamic record. And associating the time interval with the features to construct a price learning sample, establishing feature and transaction price mapping to allocate weights, and further generating a center price and an offset range to determine a second-hand vehicle entrance and exit price upper and lower boundary prediction interval. According to the method, a sample library is constructed by associating customs declaration detection storage order information with identification codes, quantitative supply and demand are compared to establish a competition set, multi-stage scoring is tracked to evaluate vehicle condition fluctuation, declaration prices, circulation intervals, supply and demand and vehicle condition features are integrated to establish learning samples, and weights are distributed through feature mapping. And generating a center price and an offset range to determine a second-hand vehicle entrance and exit price prediction interval.
CN122288773.assignee: JILIN YUEXUAN AUTOMOTIVE TECH CO LTD

KR20260075482.title: AI Used car transaction brokerage computer system and method using artificial intelligence AI price tracking algorithm
KR20260075482.abstract: 본 발명에서는 적어도 하나의 하드웨어 프로세서와 중고자동차 거래 중개 관련 프로그램을 저장한 메모리를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 하드웨어 프로세서가 상기 메모리에 저장된 프로그램의 실행을 제어하는 컴퓨터로서, 판매자의 보유 중고자동차의 시세 정보와 관련하여 인공지능(AI) 가격추적수단의 기반으로 상기 중고자동차의 최적 가격정보 및 최적 판매시점 정보를 포함하는 가격추적산출데이터를 산출하고; 상기 가격추적산출데이터를 중고자동차의 시세와 관련된 배경지식으로 하여 결정한 보유 중고자동차의 희망 판매가격 및 판매시점 정보를 포함하는 중고자동차의 판매신청 정보를 상기 판매자로부터 제공받고; 상기 판매자의 중고자동차의 판매신청 정보를 기반으로 적어도 하나의 딜러가 제공하는 중고자동차의 구매 입찰서를 수신하여 상기 판매자에게 제공하고; 상기 판매자로부터 특정 구매 입찰서의 선택 정보를 수신하여 상기 특정 구매 입찰서를 제공한 딜러에게 상기 선택 정보를 전송하고; 상기 판매자와 딜러간의 상기 중고자동차 매매계약 체결정보를 수신하는 것을 특징으로 하는 인공지능(AI) 가격추적 알고리즘을 이용한 중고자동차의 거래중개컴퓨터, 시스템 및 방법이 제시된다.

KR20260063100.title: AI New car trading brokerage computer using artificial intelligence AI price tracking algorithm and system and method thereof
KR20260063100.abstract: 본 발명에서는, 적어도 하나의 하드웨어 프로세서와 신차 거래 중개 관련 프로그램을 저장한 메모리를 포함하고 온라인 신차 거래를 중개하는 신차거래중개컴퓨터로서, 신차 구매를 원하는 구매자가 제공한 신차 정보를 포함하는 신차 구매 요청 정보를 저장하고, 상기 구매자의 신차 구매 요청 정보를 기초로 인공지능(AI) 가격추적 기반으로 제공되는 신차 관련 가격정보 및 구매시점 정보를 포함하는 가격추적산출 정보를 수신하고, 적어도 하나의 판매자 그룹으로 저장된 판매자들에게 제공한 구매자가 구매 요청한 신차 정보 및 상기 신차 관련 가격추적산출 정보를 기초로 제공하는 신차 견적 정보가 포함된 판매자들의 입찰서를 수신하고, 상기 판매자들의 입찰서 중 하나를 선택하고 선택한 입찰서와 상기 입찰서를 제공한 판매자의 정보를 구매자에게 제공하고, 상기 구매자와 선택된 판매자 간의 신차 매매 계약 정보를 저장하는 것을 특징으로 하는 인공지능(AI) 가격추적 알고리즘을 이용한 신차 거래 중개 컴퓨터, 이를 이용한 시스템 및 방법이 제시된다.

CN121836763.title: Second-hand car price rationality judgment method and product
CN121836763.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price rationality judgment method and a product, and solves the problem that in the prior art, a residual value estimation method based on a car license age limit neglects key factors such as the actual use condition, the color and the region of a car; the dynamic change of the market supply-demand relationship cannot be reflected; the method solves the problems that average value estimation based on similar vehicle prices cannot accurately measure the comprehensive influence of factors such as vehicle conditions on the prices and is easily interfered by abnormal high-price or low-price samples, so that the estimated value is unstable. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring an on-sale second-hand vehicle data set of a target vehicle model; step S2, carrying out normalization processing on the continuous characteristic variables in the data set; s3, training the normalized data set by using a machine learning regression model to obtain a price prediction model; and S4, performing price prediction on a target vehicle by using the price prediction model to obtain a predicted price.

CN121504521.title: Second-hand car price evaluation model training method and device based on deep learning
CN121504521.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price evaluation model training method and device based on deep learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the historical transaction data of a second-hand car, and carrying out the data preprocessing, and obtaining a training sample; selecting samples from the training samples to construct a sample pair of the to-be-evaluated sample and the real sample; respectively inputting the real sample and the to-be-evaluated sample into a first sub-network and a second sub-network of the double-tower model to obtain a first sample vector and a second sample vector; wherein the first sub-network and the second sub-network both adopt a deep cross network architecture; performing element-level product on the first sample vector and the second sample vector to obtain an interactive feature vector, and mapping the interactive feature vector into a scalar through an output layer; all parameters of the double-tower model are updated through back propagation according to the scalar and the loss function of the sample price difference, a trained second-hand car price evaluation model is obtained, and the problems that a second-hand car price prediction method is weak in feature intersection and insufficient in sample relevance utilization are solved.

CN121437074.title: Big data analysis-based car rental automatic price adjustment method
CN121437074.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of car rental price adjustment, and discloses a car rental automatic price adjustment method based on big data analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining the user information data of each car rental platform through each platform data collection unit; s2, acquiring vehicle information data of each vehicle model through a vehicle information module; s3, client selection data are acquired through a client selection module; s4, analyzing the user information data, the vehicle information data and the customer selection data through an analysis module, and obtaining the real-time vehicle renting price of each vehicle model of each vehicle renting platform; according to the technical scheme, the price of the same vehicle model can be automatically adjusted according to the vehicle renting platform, the vehicle information data and the user information data without manual operation, the vehicle renting transaction rate is increased, and the after-sales problem caused by errors caused by manual operation is avoided.

CN121391310.title: Second-hand car price prediction method and system
CN121391310.abstract: The invention provides a second-hand vehicle price prediction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle price evaluation, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining second-hand vehicle transaction data; preprocessing the data, including missing value processing and abnormal value detection and processing, and splitting an integer form date feature into three sub-features of year, month and day; performing feature engineering processing including feature classification, target price variable logarithm transformation and feature selection; training a gradient lifting decision tree model, and applying tree structure pruning parameters and a parallel computing strategy; evaluating model performance; analyzing feature importance by applying an SHAP method; outputting an optimized model and an interpretability analysis result, and reducing the training time by 84% and the model volume by 50% while keeping the prediction precision through a feature selection and model pruning collaborative optimization strategy; a black box problem is solved by introducing an SHAP analysis method, and a visual basis is provided for business decision making; and optimal balance of prediction precision, calculation efficiency and model transparency is realized.
CN121391310.assignee: HANGZHOU CAOHUI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

CN121169435.title: Second-hand car price prediction method based on hybrid model
CN121169435.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price prediction method based on a hybrid model. The second-hand car price prediction method comprises the steps of calculating a brand reputation index, a car rare index and a configuration complexity score through enhanced feature engineering; carrying out price interval classification on the to-be-predicted vehicle by adopting an improved K-nearest neighbor algorithm; according to the price interval, calling a constructed layered random forest model to carry out accurate price prediction; and setting an initial weight based on the price interval, carrying out weighted fusion on prediction results of the K nearest neighbor algorithm and the random forest through a dynamic weight fusion algorithm, and carrying out calculation to obtain a final price prediction value and a confidence interval. According to the method, the calculation efficiency is improved, the prediction precision is remarkably improved, rare vehicle model prediction is highlighted, the robustness is enhanced, and the cost effectiveness is remarkable.
CN121169435.assignee: SUZHOU ZHEYUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN121169590.title: Car insurance price processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
CN121169590.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, can be applied to business system platforms such as financial science and technology, and discloses a vehicle insurance price processing method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an impact factor affecting the vehicle insurance price of a target vehicle, and carrying out the preprocessing of the impact factor; wherein the influence factors comprise structured data and text data; performing embedding operation on the preprocessed influence factors to obtain vector representation of the influence factors, and constructing a nonlinear relation of the vector representation; performing feature extraction on the text data to obtain text features, analyzing the text features, and extracting correction coefficients in the text features; using the correction coefficient to correct a prediction result generated by a pre-trained vehicle insurance price prediction model through the vector representation to obtain a vehicle insurance pricing result of the target vehicle; therefore, the accuracy and adaptability of car insurance pricing can be effectively improved.
CN121169590.assignee: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

CN120410682.title: Online car-hailing dynamic price adjustment and order sending method and system, and computer equipment
CN120410682.abstract: The invention provides an online car-hailing dynamic price adjustment and order sending method and system, and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an order receiving mode and driver portrait data set by a driver through a driver end; according to the driver portrait data, the total number of drivers capable of receiving orders in various order receiving modes in the order sending range of the target order is selected; determining an estimated amount type of the target order according to a preset estimated amount type configuration; based on preset price adjustment rules matched with different order receiving time period types, according to the estimated amount type and the total number of drivers capable of receiving orders, determining a final price adjustment multiplying power and a target order sending type of the target order; and sending the target order based on the final price adjustment multiplying power and the target order sending type. According to the invention, the dynamic price adjustment is carried out according to the order receiving mode set by the driver, the problems existing in the peak and the flat period in the prior art are effectively solved by optimizing the order distribution in the peak and setting the price reduction order sending strategy, and the platform operation efficiency, the driver income and the user satisfaction are greatly improved.
CN120410682.assignee: BEIJING XINGYUN ONLINE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

CN120181889.title: Dynamic price adjustment method and system in online car-hailing order explosion scene
CN120181889.abstract: The invention relates to the related field of online car-hailing scheduling management, and discloses a dynamic price adjustment method and system in an online car-hailing order-exploding scene, which perform price increase coefficient calculation through indexes of real-time big data statistics, refine to a honeycomb dimension, solve the problem that the price increase of the whole city is not fine enough, and improve the price increase efficiency. Meanwhile, the price increase coefficient is dynamically adjusted through the driver busy degree, and the problem that manual setting of the price adjustment coefficient is unreasonable is effectively solved.

WO2025116072.title: SYSTÈME DE DÉTERMINATION DE PRIX DE VOITURES DE LOCATION
WO2025116072.abstract: The present invention relates to a rental car price determination system and, more specifically, to a rental car price determination system in which: a rental car use rate is predicted by analyzing a correlation between a use rate of rental cars and a reservation rate of accommodations in a tourist destination, and a rental car price is determined according to the predicted use rate, so that it is possible to determine a reasonable rental car price; and the rental car price is adjusted and provided in accordance with a rental car use state, a driving habit of a rental car reservation holder, a price change degree of nearby rental car companies, and whether a system-linked tourism product, etc. is purchased, so that the rationality of the rental car price can be increased.
