KR20250057569.title: SERVER FOR PROVIDING USED CAR FAIR PRICE CALCULATION SERVICE AND METHOD THEREOF
KR20250057569.abstract: The present invention relates to a used car proper price calculation service providing server and an operating method thereof. More specifically, a method for providing an appropriate used car price calculation service according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving, by an appropriate used car price calculation server, a used car price calculation request from a user electronic device; collecting first reason for reduction information on a vehicle management history from at least one external server based on the used car price calculation request; requesting second reason for reduction information on a current vehicle state from the user electronic device based on the used car price calculation request and the first reason for reduction information; receiving the second reason for reduction information from at least one of the user electronic device and a mechanic electronic device; calculating an appropriate used car price based on the first reason for reduction information and the second reason for reduction information; and providing information on the calculated appropriate used car price to the user electronic device.

CN119904283.title: Second-hand car price prediction method, system and equipment based on multi-model fusion
CN119904283.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price prediction method, system and device based on multi-model fusion. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first text input by a first user; inputting the first text into the large language model to obtain a first financial scheme; obtaining a second text input by the first user; obtaining a first evaluation for the first financial scheme in the second text; obtaining first transaction data of the first user, and clustering the first user according to the first transaction data and the first evaluation to obtain a clustering result; establishing a transaction prediction model according to a clustering result; obtaining dialogue data to be detected, and obtaining future transaction prediction data according to the dialogue data to be detected and the transaction prediction model; and optimizing the financial scheme according to the future transaction prediction data. The problems that an existing automobile financial service financial scheme is slow in feedback response to markets and users, slow in perception of user demand changes and insufficient in accuracy are at least solved.
CN119904283.assignee: SICHUAN WANWANG XINCHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN119477396.title: Dynamic price adjustment method and device based on online car-hailing supply-demand relationship, medium and equipment
CN119477396.abstract: The invention provides a dynamic price adjustment method and device based on an online car-hailing supply-demand relationship, a medium and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: determining a current honeycomb region located in a target city, and obtaining historical order data and quasi-real-time order data in the current honeycomb region; based on the historical order data and the quasi-real-time order data, analyzing supply and demand related indexes of the current honeycomb area; the supply and demand related indexes comprise historical supply and demand related indexes and quasi-real-time supply and demand related indexes; calculating a historical price adjustment rate and a quasi-real-time adjustment rate based on the historical supply and demand related indexes and the quasi-real-time supply and demand related indexes respectively; calculating a final price adjustment multiplying power based on the calculated historical price adjustment multiplying power and the quasi-real-time adjustment multiplying power; and performing price adjustment on the online car-hailing order of the current honeycomb area by using the final price adjustment multiplying power. According to the invention, historical and real-time data are comprehensively considered, multiple indexes are integrated, the weight is set to judge the supply and demand relationship of the online car-hailing platform, the price adjustment rate is dynamically adjusted, and the operation effect of the online car-hailing platform is greatly improved.
CN119477396.assignee: BEIJING XINGYUN ONLINE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

CN119295122.title: Online car-hailing price elasticity evaluation method, device and equipment and storage medium
CN119295122.abstract: The invention relates to an online car-hailing price elasticity evaluation method, apparatus and device, and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining transaction data of an online car-hailing platform; wherein the transaction data comprises inquiry time, order placing time, a vehicle type, mileage, a pre-estimated price, order completion information and supply and demand information; selecting features based on the transaction data according to a principle that the greater the correlation with price elasticity is, the more priority is; constructing a DML price elastic model; wherein the DML price elastic model comprises two sub-modules, and one sub-module is used for estimating the online car-hailing price serving as a processing variable; the other sub-module is used for estimating a riding demand serving as a response variable; based on the transaction data, a residual error fitting mode is adopted, and a Cross-fitting algorithm is used to train a DML price elasticity model; and based on the trained DML price elasticity model, carrying out price elasticity evaluation on the online car-hailing price to obtain an evaluation result.
CN119295122.assignee: BEIJING YUNXING ONLINE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

CN119090532.title: Price determination method, device and equipment for online car-hailing fixed-price order
CN119090532.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic, and discloses a price determination method, device and equipment for an online car-hailing fixed-price order, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first target information, the first target information comprises first order information of a target fixed-price order sent by the user and first supply and demand information of an urban area corresponding to the target fixed-price order at the current moment; inputting the first target information and each price adjustment ratio into a pre-trained first deep learning model, and predicting an order completion rate corresponding to each price adjustment ratio; and according to the price adjustment ratio with the highest order completion rate, adjusting the initial quotation of the target fixed-price order to obtain the final quotation of the target fixed-price order. According to the invention, the order completion rate of each price adjustment ratio is predicted according to the actual order information and the online car-hailing supply and demand information, and then the price adjustment ratio with the highest order completion rate is determined as the price adjustment ratio, so that the driver cancellation rate of online car-hailing fixed-price orders can be reduced.
CN119090532.assignee: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD

CN118780834.title: Method and device for dynamically adjusting price of online car-hailing order in real time
CN118780834.abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for dynamically adjusting the price of an online car-hailing order in real time, particularly relates to the technical field of data processing and intelligent transportation, and can adjust the price of the online car-hailing order in real time to balance supply and demand. For example, the price is increased in the peak period, order issuing of some passengers who do not take the taxi urgently is reduced, and meanwhile more drivers are induced to receive orders in the current time period. The overall income of the platform is improved while the taxi taking pressure is relieved; meanwhile, the price adjustment mode of the system is automated through systematic testing, excessive dependence on manpower is reduced to the maximum extent, an operator does not need to keep excessive monitoring on supply and demand of the system all the time, and meanwhile, the operator does not need to manually adjust the order price according to experience each time; compared with manual conservative price adjustment, the price adjustment result generated by the simulation system can maximize platform benefits.
CN118780834.assignee: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD

CN118735650.title: Online car-hailing order price monitoring method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
CN118735650.abstract: The invention relates to an online car-hailing order price monitoring method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: in response to received online car-hailing travel order information of a target tenant, obtaining a current online car-hailing mileage configuration unit price set; according to the quotient of the target mileage configuration unit price difference and the target mileage configuration unit price standard difference, determining a variation degree evaluation score of the mileage configuration unit price of the target tenant; wherein the target mileage configuration unit price difference is a difference value between the mileage configuration unit price of the target tenant and the average value of each target mileage configuration unit price; the target mileage configuration unit price standard deviation is the standard deviation of each target mileage configuration unit price; if the variation degree evaluation score is greater than an evaluation score threshold, outputting first online car-hailing order price abnormity alarm information to the target tenant; the first online car-hailing order price abnormity alarm information is used for representing that the mileage configuration unit price of the target tenant is abnormal relative to each target mileage configuration unit price. The method is adopted to identify the rationality of the mileage fee unit price of the tenant.
CN118735650.assignee: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD

CN118608218.title: Online car-hailing service provider price determination method and system
CN118608218.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of online car-hailing services, and discloses an online car-hailing service provider price determination method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the target car scale data of a target online car-hailing service provider and the non-target car scale data of a non-target online car-hailing service provider; based on the target vehicle scale data and the non-target vehicle scale data, calculating autonomous pricing data of the target online car-hailing service provider without relying on an aggregation platform, and determining autonomous profit data of the target online car-hailing service provider; based on the target vehicle scale data and the non-target vehicle scale data, calculating platform pricing data of the target online car-hailing service provider depending on an aggregation platform, and determining platform profit data of the target online car-hailing service provider according to the platform pricing data; comparing the autonomous profit data with the platform profit data, and determining the pricing of the target online car-hailing service provider according to the comparison result; according to the method, an online car-hailing service provider is helped to provide a decision on pricing, and the maximum benefit is maintained while the aggregation platform enters the market.

KR20240124550.title: Video based determination system for selling price of used car
KR20240124550.abstract: Provided is a video-based system for determining selling price of a used vehicle comprising: a vehicle identification number input unit for receiving a vehicle identification number of a used vehicle that a seller intends to sell; a listing search unit for searching for used vehicle listings of the same vehicle type as the used vehicle corresponding to the vehicle identification number input through the vehicle identification number input unit; a vehicle video display unit for displaying vehicle videos for used vehicle listings; and a video-based selling price determination unit for determining a video-based selling price of the used vehicle corresponding to the vehicle identification number based on the vehicle videos displayed by the vehicle video display unit. According to the present invention, the used vehicle seller determines the selling price of the used vehicle by searching for the used vehicle under a similar condition to the used vehicle that the used vehicle seller wants to sell. Therefore, the used vehicle seller determines the selling price of the used vehicle. Accordingly, the used vehicle seller registers the used vehicle in a used vehicle trading system and sells the used vehicle.

KR20240117828.title: Device for providing used electric car battery price calculation service
KR20240117828.abstract: The present invention relates to a device for providing a service of calculating the battery price of a used electric vehicle. The device comprises: a battery value diagnosis learning model configuration unit for constructing a battery value diagnosis learning model configured to measure a battery value evaluation value of an electric vehicle; a data acquisition unit for acquiring battery management system (BMS) data of the electric vehicle; a battery value grade calculation unit for calculating a battery value evaluation grade by inputting the BMS data into the battery value diagnosis learning model; and a battery price calculation unit for calculating a standard price of a battery based on the battery value evaluation grade.

CN117994050.title: Car insurance risk control management method based on part price and readable storage medium
CN117994050.abstract: The invention discloses a part price-based automobile insurance risk control management method and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining original automobile part data of multiple data sources, and carrying out the cleaning according to a preset rule, and obtaining target automobile part data; and according to the target data, obtaining a first statistical result and a second statistical result, and further determining a target part price screening result. Based on the screening result, a part price management system is constructed. When claim settlement task initiation information is received, the system outputs a corresponding claim settlement result and carries out risk assessment on the result. Through the design, more accurate and efficient part price management and risk control can be provided, so that the risk and cost of the automobile insurance industry are effectively reduced, and the service efficiency is improved.
CN117994050.assignee: DELIAN YIKONG TECH BEIJING CO LTD

CN117911057.title: Second-hand car price prediction method, device and equipment and storage medium
CN117911057.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price prediction method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: inputting target second-hand car data into a target second-hand car price prediction model, and obtaining a second-hand car price prediction value, the target second-hand car price prediction model is a model obtained by introducing Chebyshev chaotic mapping, a nonlinear decline disturbance factor and an adaptive weight factor to improve a Harris eagle algorithm and then optimizing hyper-parameters of a LightGBM model based on the improved Harris eagle algorithm. The Chebyshev chaotic mapping, the nonlinear decline disturbance factor and the adaptive weight factor are introduced to improve the Harris eagle algorithm, and then second-hand car price prediction is performed based on the target second-hand car price prediction model obtained by optimizing the hyper-parameter of the LightGBM by using the improved Harris eagle algorithm. The accuracy and stability of second-hand car price prediction are effectively improved.

CN117852676.title: Generation method and device of online car-hailing order price guidance template, equipment and medium
CN117852676.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile services, and discloses an online car-hailing order price guidance template generation method and device, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: calculating a basic pricing template according to a preset pricing template of each tenant on an online car-hailing multi-tenant aggregation platform and the number of response orders; adjusting the basic pricing template to obtain basic pricing templates of different pricing standards; order information of orders issued by passengers is obtained, and the estimated price of the corresponding order is calculated according to the pricing standard of each basic pricing template; simulating an order response process, and predicting an order completion rate of orders published by the passengers; and selecting the basic pricing template with the highest order completion rate as the price guidance template of the online car-hailing multi-tenant aggregation platform. According to the method, the price guidance template with wider applicability is obtained, price guidance is provided for users, excessive dependence of tenants on manpower when the pricing template is configured is reduced, the experience threshold of new tenants is reduced, and the configuration process of the pricing template is more intelligent and reasonable.
CN117852676.assignee: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD

CN117764614.title: Second-hand car price evaluation method and device
CN117764614.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price evaluation method and device, relates to the technical field of big data analysis and application, and can solve the problems that in the prior art, the second-hand car price mainly depends on artificial experience evaluation, the evaluation result is unstable, and the efficiency is low. According to the specific technical scheme, the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining target second-hand car data and a corresponding target price, wherein the target second-hand car data comprises at least one of car condition information, color information, mileage information, region information, transfer frequency information and use property information; converting the target price into a first standard price according to a preset first influence coefficient of each vehicle system and target second-hand vehicle data; calculating an estimated price corresponding to the target price according to the first standard price and the first influence coefficient; and finally, carrying out dynamic iteration on the estimated price, and outputting a second-hand car price evaluation model when a preset dynamic planning target is reached. The second-hand car price evaluation method is used for second-hand car price evaluation.
CN117764614.assignee: SHANGHAI ZHONGDIAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN117593061.title: Method for improving online car-hailing order price estimation accuracy
CN117593061.abstract: The invention discloses a method for improving online car-hailing order price estimation accuracy, and the method comprises the steps: S1, after a user selects a getting-on and getting-off address, a passenger end APP sends an estimation request, and an LBS system returns three groups of estimated mileage, estimated duration, highway fee and routeID to a billing system through an estimation interface for the calculation of an estimated price; s2, the LBS system returns the labels, the estimated mileage, the estimated duration, the real-time road conditions and the route tracks of the three routes to the agent layer; the LBS system informs the passenger terminal of the route with the lowest estimated price, so that the passenger terminal can select the route by default; s3, according to the estimated price returned by the charging system, the track and the road condition returned by the routeID and the LBS system are returned to the passenger side from low price to high price for display; according to the invention, the user selects the route before ordering according to his/her habit, and the online car-hailing platform carries out price estimation according to the actual driving route, so that the accuracy of the estimated price is improved, and user complaints caused by the inconsistency of the estimated price and the actual price are reduced.

KR20230123752.title: A used car purchase platform that allows you to check the average market price of your own vehicle and purchase it with a professional technician.
KR20230123752.abstract: The present invention relates to a used car purchase platform that allows a user to check the average market price of a user's vehicle and purchase it with a professional technician and, more specifically, to a used car purchase platform that allows a user to check the average market price of a user's vehicle and purchase it with a professional technician, wherein the user can check the average market price of a user's vehicle, and visit a used car sales complex with a professional technician for a systematic used car verification service, thereby allowing the user to purchase a used car in a more professional and transparent manner. The platform includes: a buyer terminal; a trading management server; and a vehicle management server.

CN121256752.title: Off-line software license tamper-proof verification system and method based on first networking activation
CN121256752.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer software security and digital rights management, and particularly relates to an offline software license tamper-proofing verification system and method based on first networking activation. The multi-NTP server time synchronization module is used for acquiring trusted network time from a plurality of NTP servers; a license signature verification module; the local timestamp encryption storage module is used for encrypting credible time and hardware fingerprints and then storing the credible time and the hardware fingerprints into a plurality of hidden paths; the off-line time integrity verification module is used for verifying system time integrity in an off-line environment; the hardware fault-tolerant module is used for generating a device fingerprint and processing a hardware change scene; and the version compatibility module is used for providing a flexible version matching strategy. According to the invention, an authorization mode that only first networking activation is needed and subsequent complete offline work is needed is realized, and the problems of continuous networking dependence, easy tampering, time rollback, hardware change mistaken killing and the like in the prior art are effectively solved.
CN121256752.assignee: KUNTYE VEHICLE SYS CHANGZHOU CO LTD

WO2025153897.title: UTILISATION DE THÉORIES DE PREMIER ORDRE D'ALGÈBRES BOOLÉENS POUR FOURNIR DES SYSTÈMES IA SÛRS ET UNE NOUVELLE LOGIQUE DE SPÉCIFICATION LOGICIELLE

The command is expressed in an extended formal language comprising elements in a Boolean Algebra. The platform retrieving validation rules for the software platform. The validation rules are expressed in the extended formal language. The platform combines the command and the validation rules to build a formula in the extended formal language, including one or more logical quantifiers. The platform expresses the formula in disjunctive normal form, with an existential innermost quantifier and constructs a new formula in the extended formal language that is logically equivalent to the formula and has no quantifiers. The platform evaluates the truth of the new formula and executes the command to perform the action when the new formula is true. Otherwise, the platform rejects the command.

CN119598446.title: Method and device for operating first software in multi-hard-disk mode
CN119598446.abstract: The invention provides a method for operating first software in a multi-hard-disk mode, the method is suitable for electronic equipment with multiple hard disks, and the method comprises the steps that when a first software calling instruction from a user is received in response, state information of the multiple hard disks is acquired through a BIOS; determining the hard disk where the first software is located based on the state information of the hard disks; adjusting a partition table of a hard disk where the first software is located, wherein the partition table at least comprises a security partition where the first software is located; opening the security partition; first software located in the security partition is operated; wherein the first software comprises an executable drive program, a file, system software or application software. The invention further provides a device for operating the first software in the multi-hard-disk mode.

US12141138.title: Data access layer for translating between a data structure used by a first software program and a proxy table used by a second software program
US12141138.abstract: In one example, a system can receive information about a data structure including a set of data entries. The system can generate a proxy data table including a set of columns. The system can use a data access layer to generate a mapping from the data entries to the columns. The system can receive an input to cause an operation to be performed on the data structure by performing the operation on the data structure. Generating a result can involve issuing read commands to the data access layer to perform the operation on the data structure such that the data access layer obtains the associated data entries and provides them as responses to the read commands by performing a translation between the data entries and the columns based on the mapping. The system can then output the result of the operation.

CN117171055.title: Software radio conformity test method based on depth-first
CN117171055.abstract: The invention relates to a software radio conformance test method based on depth-first, which comprises the following steps of: 1, creating a precondition list by taking a domain manager conforming to an SCA specification as an initial node; 2, taking an interface defined in the specification as a precondition of a test node, searching whether the precondition of the test node is met or not, if not, taking the precondition as a secondary test requirement and recording, and executing the step 3; if yes, executing step 5; 3, meeting a secondary test requirement through the domain manager, otherwise, returning to the step 2; 4, after all secondary test requirements and preconditions are met, executing the step 5, otherwise, returning to the step 3; 5, completing a test requirement; and 6, if the system state is modified in the test, executing the preconditions in an inverted order, and recovering the system to the state before the test. According to the method, the period of developing the software radio conformance test software is remarkably shortened, the defect of dependence on a test set during testing is eliminated, and the stability and reliability of testing are guaranteed.

JP2023154683.title: FIRST TABLE AND SECOND TABLE OF DATA FILE CAPABLE OF PROCESSING WITH SPREADSHEET SOFTWARE AND DOCUMENT CREATION SUPPORTING DEVICE
JP2023154683.abstract: To provide a supporting device of a document creation capable of creating prescribed format documents including tables by simple operation and to provide tables.SOLUTION: The cell height and the cell width in a first table are unchangeably predetermined. Static information and variable information are recorded in the first table and the sheet is printed. The document creation supporting device can create documents by using a second table with second table variable information varied by individuals since the cell height and cell width in the static part and the variable part are adjusted so that the document conforms to a prescribed form. It is set that the variable information in the first table variable part is overwritten by the second table variable information recorded in the second table by pasting the state that the setting of pasting without blanks is selected when the second table variable information recorded in the second table is pasted in the first table. US20240126715.title: System management software with system vital product data (SVPD) for comparing first and second server identity data
US20240126715.abstract: A method for replacing at least one hardware assembly of a data processing apparatus includes managing, by a system management software, the data processing apparatus with a service processor and a plurality of hardware assemblies, obtaining, by the system management software, first system configuration data, first system vital product data (SVPD), and first server identity data of the data processing apparatus from the service processor or through the service processor, obtaining, by the system management software, second SVD and second server identity data of the data processing apparatus from the service processor or through the service processor, comparing, by the system management software, the first server identity data with the second server identity data, and configuring, by the system management software, the data processing apparatus based on the first system configuration data and the first SVPD according to a comparison result.

US2022245052.title: Method and device of protecting a first software application to generate a protected software application
US2022245052.abstract: Protection of a first software application to be executed on an execution platform by adding at least one check module to the software application, wherein the check module, when being executed, checks at least a part of the code of the protected software application loaded in the memory and carries out a predefined tamper response in case the check module detects that the checked code was changed or ensures that the protected software application continues to function correctly in case the check module detects that the checked code was not changed; selecting a first code region of the first software application, said first code region provides a first functionality when being executed; amending the selected first code region of the first software application such that an amended first code region is generated to provide the protected software application; wherein the amended first code region, when being executed, still provides the first functionality but carries out an access to at least a part of the code of a protected software application loaded in the memory for providing the first functionality.

US2022236977.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ANALYZING FIRST PARTY DATA FROM ONE OR MORE SOFTWARE TOOLS
US2022236977.abstract: Technologies for retrieving first party data from external sources and generating an entity execution score is provided. The disclosed techniques include joining a cloud-based software application, signing into the cloud-based software application, and requesting certain company related information. The disclosed techniques may further comprise the steps of selecting a company industry vertical, selecting a company funding stage, and providing relevant licensed software tools to be selected. The disclosed techniques may further comprise selecting at least one licensed software tool, integrating the at least one licensed software tool into the cloud-based software application, and initiating a return of data related to a key performance indicator using a company's own, or first party data from the at least one licensed software tool. An execution score is algorithmically computed based in part on at least one key performance indicator data.

CN114546826.title: Software development first iteration test interface analysis method
CN114546826.abstract: The invention discloses a software development first iterative test interface analysis method, which comprises the following steps of: (1) calling a precise test system based on a Java back end through a use case management system, and displaying a popup window on the use case management system by the precise test system based on the Java back end; (2) calling an interface analysis system based on a Java back end through the precise test system, wherein the interface analysis system displays a popup window on the precise test system based on the Java back end; and (3) calling an application information input module based on a Java back end through an interface analysis system, inputting basic information of the application, and then calling a data management system by the application information input module based on the Java back end. According to the method, a precise test system is improved on an independently researched and developed software development test platform, and an interface analysis system is added, so that interfaces for software testing can be quickly analyzed, the analysis result is displayed in a list form, the problem of manual one-by-one interface analysis is avoided, time and labor are saved, and human resources are effectively saved.

US2022148706.title: Mirror image apps device comprises plurality of sensors acquire video and audio data to determine first expression, software and system, and methods of operating same
US2022148706.abstract: An Mirror Image Apps, system and method of operation. A method of monitoring a Client, via an MIA process using an MIA device, the method includes (i) presenting predetermined images, self-portraits, statements, music, and/or questions, via an MIA device, to a Client associated with the MIA device, while the Client is alone, (ii) acquiring video and/or audio data, via the MIA device, of the Client's responses to the predetermined images, self-portraits, statements, music, and/or questions presented to the Client via the MIA device, (iii) analyzing the video and/or audio data, and/or changes therein, to detect the state of the Client, and (iv) determining a course of action, via a Core Group associated with the Client, for treatment of the Client based on the analysis of the video and/or audio data.

US11314489.title: Automated authoring of software solutions by first analyzing and resolving anomalies in a data model
US11314489.abstract: Before generating code from an abstract model of a data store, the model is first analyzed to detect normalization, rationalization, naming conventions, structure conventions, and other anomalies. The analysis is scored, and the score may be weighted. The analysis also suggests scripted solutions for resolving the discovered anomalies. A developer may then choose to implement one or more of the suggested solutions prior to code generation. The score may be compared to a threshold and result used to gate subsequent actions. For example, generation of code from the abstract model may be prevented until such time as anomalies are sufficiently addressed so that the score meets a minimum threshold score.

claims:
1. Verfahren zum Übertragen einer Software-Applikation (500, 550) von einer ersten (200) zu einer zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300), umfassend die nachfolgenden Schritte: a.) Ablauf einer in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) implementierten ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550), wobei im Rahmen des Ablaufs der ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) innerhalb der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200)
- eine Datenkommunikation der ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) mit einer weiteren Software-Applikation (400) und/oder einer Vorrichtung (700) erfolgt, und
- Zustandsdaten (510, 560) bezüglich eines internen Zustands der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) und/oder bezüglich eines internen Ablaufs der ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) in einer ersten Speichereinrichtung (210) gespeichert werden; b.) Übertragen von zu einem ersten Zeitpunkt in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) vorliegenden Start-Zustandsdaten (510, 560) zu einer mit der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) kommunikativ gekoppelten zweiten Speichereinrichtung (310);
c.) Starten einer in der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) implementierten zweiten Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) zu einem zweiten Zeitpunkt unter Verwendung der Start-Zustandsdaten (510, 560),
wobei die Ausführung der zweiten Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) in der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) dann derart erfolgt, dass zu einem dem zweiten Zeitpunkt nachfolgenden dritten Zeitpunkt die erste Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) und die zweite Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) in der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) synchron ablaufen;
d.) Übergabe Datenkommunikation mit der weiteren Software-Applikation (400) oder Vorrichtung (700) von der in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) implementierten ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) an die in der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) implementierten zweite Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552). 2. Verfahren gemäß Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet,- dass im Rahmen von Verfahrensschritt a.) bei der Datenkommunikation Eingabedaten von der weiteren Software-Applikation (400) und/oder Vorrichtung (700), und/oder Ausgabedaten für die weitere Software-Applikation (400) und/oder Vorrichtung (700) gespeichert werden, - dass in einem weiteren, dem Verfahrensschritt b.) vorausgehenden Verfahrensschritt a1.) ein Tracing-Ablauf zur Speicherung von jeweils aktuellen Eingabe- und/oder Ausgabedaten in einer I/O-Tracing-Datenbank (330) gestartet wird, und
- dass im Rahmen des Verfahrensschritts c.) das Starten der zweiten Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) weiterhin unter Verwendung von in der I/O-Tracing-Datenbank (330) bezüglich des ersten Zeitpunkts gespeicherten Eingabe- und/oder Ausgabedaten erfolgt. 3. Verfahren nach Anspruch 2, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass den in der I/O-Tracing-Datenbank (330) gespeicherten Eingabe- und/oder Ausgabedaten jeweils mindestens ein Zeitwert zugeordnet ist. 4. Verfahren nach einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass das Verfahren derart ausgestaltet und eingerichtet ist, dass die Datenkommunikation mit der weiteren Software-Applikation (400) und/oder der Vorrichtung (700) unterbrechungsfrei abläuft. 5. Verfahren nach einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass die erste Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) und die zweite Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) in der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) jeweils zyklisch ausgeführt werden. 6. Verfahren nach einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass die erste (200) und zweite Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) jeweils ein Echtzeit-Betriebssystem umfassen, wobei die Ausführung der ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) und die Ausführung der zweiten Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) in der zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) jeweils im Rahmen des jeweiligen Echtzeit-Betriebssystems der jeweiligen Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200, 300) erfolgt. 7. Verfahren nach einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass die erste (500, 550) und zweite Instanz der Software-Applikation (502, 552) jeweils zur Echtzeit-Datenkommunikation mit der weiteren Software-Applikation (400) und/oder der Vorrichtung (700) ausgebildet und eingerichtet sind. 8. Verfahren gemäß einem der vorstehend genannten Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass die Datenkommunikation unter Verwendung eines von den beteiligten Kommunikationspartnern gemeinsam genutzten Speicherbereichs erfolgt. 9. Verfahren nach einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass im Rahmen eines Einrichtens der ersten Instanz der Software-Applikation (500, 550) in der ersten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (200) eine Kennzeichnung der Zustandsdaten (510, 560) erfolgt. 10. Verfahren nach einem der vorhergehenden Ansprüche, dadurch gekennzeichnet,dass die erste (200) und zweite Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) jeweils als eine Steuereinrichtung zur Steuerung einer Vorrichtung oder Anlage ausgebildet und eingerichtet ist. 11. Datenverarbeitungssystem (100) umfassend eine erste (200) und zweite Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) gemäß einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche,
wobei das Datenverarbeitungssystem (100) zum Übertragen einer Software-Applikation (500, 550) von der ersten (200) zur zweiten Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung (300) vermittels eines Verfahrens gemäß einem der vorstehenden Ansprüche ausgebildet und eingerichtet ist.

US2023148058.title: Storage medium and control method of information processing apparatus utilizing first and second print control software creating first and second format print data
US2023148058.abstract: An object of the present disclosure is to provide a printing system capable of supporting a plurality of printable areas for one paper size. One embodiment of the present invention is a non-transitory computer readable storage medium storing a program for causing a computer to perform a control method in an information processing apparatus including: first printing control software; and second printing control software that converts first format print data output by the first printing control software into second format print data, and the control method includes: a first creation step of creating raster data based on the first format print data; a medium determination step of performing determination of whether a printing-target medium is a medium that needs a margin larger than a regular size; and a margin insertion step of performing margin insertion processing for raster data created at the first creation step.

US2021274335.title: Communication device and communication method for transmitting notifications to communicate with first and second softwares and to cause second software to be on standby and to cancel being on standby
US2021274335.abstract: [0001]    An electronic clock which is a communication device includes: a transceiver configured to communicate with another communication device including first software and second software; and at least one processor. The processor: controls the transceiver to perform a certain communication with the first software; and causes, after the certain communication ends, the transceiver to transmit a notification for notifying the second software of the end of the certain communication.

CN112562838.title: Method for deducing large-batch patient first-aid sand table through instant messaging software
CN112562838.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sand table deduction, and discloses a method for deducing a large-batch patient first-aid sand table through instant messaging software, which comprisesa teacher end, a commander end, a large-screen terminal, student ends, an instant messaging server and a digital model, and is characterized in that the digital model is in bidirectional connection with the instant messaging server; and the instant messaging server is in bidirectional connection with the teacher end, the instant messaging server is in bidirectional connection with thecommander end, the instant messaging server is in bidirectional connection with the large-screen terminal, and the instant messaging server is in bidirectional connection with the student ends. According to the method for deducing a large-batch patient first-aid sand table through instant messaging software, through the teacher end, the commander end, the large-screen terminal, the student ends and the instant messaging server, the teacher end, the commander end, the large-screen terminal and the student ends are all in two-way connection with the instant messaging server, timely transmission of data is ensured, and the data transmission efficiency is improved, and therefore, the deduction speed is increased, and the purpose of high deduction speed is achieved.

CN112165524.title: Pre-hospital first-aid intelligent calling software system
CN112165524.abstract: The invention discloses a pre-hospital first-aid intelligent calling software system, an intelligent first-aid program set is a software system used when a patient needs first-aid service, an intelligent platform data server is a cloud platform built based on a distributed technology and is used for storing system related data, and a platform operation and maintenance gateway is a platform callingcore, and is used for service scheduling, load balancing and failover. A data standard bus is used for standardized exchange of all data inside and outside the system, and a data middle station is used for standardized packaging and standardized use of services. The pre-hospital first-aid intelligent calling software system focuses on deep fusion of medical resources and first-aid resources through the mobile Internet, the Internet of Things and the artificial intelligence technology, so that the first-aid resource management and allocation capacity is improved, pre-hospital and in-hospital first-aid connection is improved, the waiting time of pre-hospital patients is greatly shortened, and intercommunication of internal and external emergency treatment information of hospitals is effectively realized; finally, the first-aid efficiency is improved, and the first-aid patient treatment level is improved.

US2020389437.title: Methods and systems for establishing a connection between a first device and a second device across a software-defined perimeter
US2020389437.abstract: [0001]    A method and system include a SDP controller in a SDP receiving a request from a first device for communicating with a second device. The second device is in the SDP. A firewall includes a connection table configured to map an identity of the first device and second device, and a filter table is configured to open and close ports. The SDP controller authenticates the first device, and provides the identity of the first device to the second device. The second device transmits a first packet to the first device. The firewall maps in the connection table, the identity of the first device in association with the second device. The first device transmits a second packet to the second device. The firewall determines that the identity of the first device is in the connection table for communicating with the second device and forwards the second packet to the second device.

TW202029719.title: Mechanism for controlling entity machine by applying conversation software including a first dialog unit, a second dialog unit, an application apparatus and a download converter
TW202029719.abstract: This invention provides a mechanism for controlling an entity machine by applying conversation software. The mechanism includes a first dialog unit, a second dialog unit, an application apparatus and a download converter. The first dialog unit corresponds to a specific conversation software unit. The first dialog unit includes a first dialog box, a first user interface and a first output unit; and a user may log in the first dialog unit by virtue of the user interface so as to perform a dialog by virtue of the first dialog box. The second dialog unit corresponds to the specific conversation software unit. The second dialog unit includes a second dialog box, a second user interface and a second output unit. The application apparatus is connected to the second dialog unit of a second electronic information apparatus, and the user may log in the second dialog unit by virtue of the second user interface so as to perform a dialog by virtue of the second dialog box. The download converter is connected to the second dialog unit and is used for converting a statement in the second dialog unit into an instruction for a machine and then transmitting the instruction via a network.

US2020183924.title: Computer program for computational and statistical analysis based on breadth first search software system linkage for optimal useful data-point patterns and probabilistic data determinants in search query results
US2020183924.abstract: This patent discloses methods, systems and computer program product for producing optimal search requests based on certain user queries and on certain user specific data. The patent describes in detail of a software system encapsulated in the form of a search engine, using the process of serendipity in network systems (digitally) and drawing data from previous user searches, user data, user specifics, and potentially utilize the data and results for more lucrative job-related opportunities. This patent describes in detail the mathematical functions, the predictive programming, the binary network formation, and the storage of constantly evolving data into one system and its manipulation for user directed searches and user beneficial results.

CN110262940.title: New method for identifying first power-on through software after offline detection
CN110262940.abstract: The invention discloses a new method for identifying first power-on through software after offline detection, the first power-on is identified through cooperative use of two kinds of software, and the two kinds of software comprise detection software and client software. According to the method, the first power-on function after the offline detection is identified is completed through the cooperative use of the two kinds of software, the method is less in modification of mass production client software, the software development period is shortened, the development cost is saved, and meanwhile, the risk is reduced.

US2019258576.title: Headless resilient backup and restore software ecosystem and with a first backup server and a second backup server in a plurality of backup servers, with the first backup server selecting a the second backup server to start a job where selection is based on historical client latency, scheduled backup server workload, and whether metadata is cached in any of the plurality of backup servers
US2019258576.abstract: [0001]    Provided are techniques for a headless resilient backup and restore software ecosystem. At a first backup server of a plurality of backup servers, a connection request is received. At the first backup server, a second backup server is identified by: determining a backup server score for each of the plurality of backup servers based on identification factors comprising historical client latency, scheduled backup server workload, and whether the metadata is already cached on any of the plurality of backup servers and identifying the second backup server as having a lowest backup server score. The identification of the second backup server is returned.

AU2018100409.title: Peopletek Employment Exchange (PEX) is a first of its kind Blockchain based online human resourcing and recruitment platform. It is a combination of Blockchain technology and Software-as-a-Service, providing a secure online software platform for personal career and company profiles to be verify and create trust through blockchain technology and cryptography, also creating privacy and security, whilst facilitating the a community employment exchange through our unique Blockchain-as-a-Service model.
AU2018100409.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in AU2018100409A4.

US2018176144.title: APPARATUS FOR SELF-REGULATER (SR) LAST-IN, FIRST-OUT (LIFO) SCHEDULING IN SOFTWARE DEFINED NETWORKS (SNDs) WITH HYBRID TRAFFIC
US2018176144.abstract: An apparatus, such as a network element, comprises a receiver to receive a plurality of packets from a plurality of traffic flows and a first non-transitory memory to form a first and second set of queues to store the plurality of packets from the plurality of traffic flows. One or more processors execute instructions stored in a second non-transitory memory to limit a rate of transfer of the plurality of packets that is output from the first set of queues to the second set of queues having a plurality of delays. A packet stored in the second set of queues is selected to be output based on a comparison of the plurality of delays.

US2021034336.title: Executing a process-based software application in a first computing environment and a second computing environment
US2021034336.abstract: Process flow is created that represents a process-based software application. User specified connector creation information for creating connectors is received. User specified element information are received for associating elements with the process flow. One of the elements is a service task, and a connector is selected and configured from the connectors. The process-based software application is executed in a first computing environment. Interactions between the process-based software application and the connector framework are provided during the executing of the process-based software application in the first computing environment. The process-based software application is executed in a second computing environment. The process-based software application does not interact with the connector framework during the executing of the process-based software application in the second computing environment.

CN107766062.title: Software installing method and system and first terminals
CN107766062.abstract: The invention relates to a software installing method and system and first terminals. The method includes that the first terminals receive an installing instruction sent by a second terminal, the second terminal is connected with at least one first terminal, each first terminal is connected with at least one third terminal, and each third terminal is a terminal waiting for installing of software;the first terminals acquire a software installing package according to the installing instruction; the first terminals install the software in each third terminal connected with the first terminals. Aterminal array of a starlike topological grid structure can be acquired according to the second terminal, the first terminals connected with the second terminal and the third terminals connected witheach first terminal; the software is installed automatically for the third terminals, so that installing efficiency is high, and labor cost and time cost are saved.
CN107766062.assignee: BEIJING XIAOMI MOBILE SOFTWARE CO LTD

CN107563117.title: Intelligent regional first-aid medical integrated data center system prototype based on software definition
CN107563117.abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent regional first-aid medical integrated data center system prototype based on a software definition. According to the characteristics of the architecture, data iscollected from a first-aid medical site, and the data is extracted, purified and loaded into a regional first-aid medical integrated data center; through aggregation processing on the data, the data is provided for a data warehouse; corresponding professional data is extracted from the data warehouse according to first-aid medical categories to form a data market; data in a knowledge base is mapped with dictionary data of a business system through matching and logic merging, and a uniform analysis access and a data service are provided; and a backbone network can run on OpenFlow and is distributed to data centers in all places through network links, so that the utilization rate of wide-area lines is increased. The intelligent regional first-aid medical integrated data center system prototype based on the software definition is constructed.

TW201738649.title: Corresponding method between panorama video and message and system thereof having cloud software calculator to obtain an angle value and a first time point from the cloud database, and calculate and search a picture of panorama video corresponding to the message
TW201738649.abstract: The present invention provides a corresponding method between panorama video and message and a system thereof. At least a panorama video is stored in a cloud server. A person who leaves a message can watch the panorama video on a portable device and may rotate or move the portable device for changing the viewing angle of panorama video. When the message-leaving person who leaves a message wants to comment upon the picture of panorama video at a first time point, he/she writes a message, and the portable device detects its own moving information by a sensor, so as to calculate an angle value of the viewing angle taken at the first time point and store the angle value and the first time point in a cloud database. When at least one user clicks on the message in a comment area near the panorama video, the cloud software calculator obtains the angle value and the first time point from the cloud database, calculates and searches the picture of panorama video which is corresponding to the message of the first time point and the viewing angle for the user to watch.

KR20260119472.title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING AN EXPLAINABLE MULTIMODAL CLINICAL DECISION SUPPORT SYSTEM
KR20260119472.abstract:
[0001a]    [본 발명은 임상 문서, 오디오, 의료 영상을 하나의 시스템에서 다중 모달로 처리하고, 표준화된 데이터로 감별진단 후보와 해석 가능한 추론 근거(Reasoning Chain), 신뢰도(Confidence Score)를 산출하며, 독립적 검증 과정을 통해 안전성을 제고하는 해석 가능한 다중 모달 임상 의사결정 지원 시스템에 관한 것이다.
이를 위해 임상 문서 처리 모듈, 오디오 처리 모듈, 의료 영상 처리 모듈이 각각 텍스트, 음성, 영상을 구조화하고, 의료 기록 표준화 모듈에서 임상적 맥락을 보존하며 표준 영어 형태로 일괄 변환 후, 진단 제안 생성 모듈이 감별진단을 제시한다. 이어서 임상 보고서 생성 모듈이 S/O/A/C 구조의 보고서를 자동 작성하고, 핵심 평가 요약 모듈이 긴급 항목을 우선 정리하며, 의료 영상 시각화 모듈이 영상 내 병변을 시각적으로 강조한다. 독립적 검증 모듈은 전체 결과물을 상시 점검하여 허위 정보나 논리적 모순을 방지한다.
특히 본 발명은 이러한 모듈들을 다중에이전트(multi-agent)로 구성하여, 각 에이전트가 상호 피드백을 교환함으로써 별도의 미세조정 없이도 포괄적이고 정확한 의료 진단 보고서를 협력 생성할 수 있다.
본 발명을 통해 의료진은 다중 모달 데이터를 효율적으로 통합 및 분석하고, 설명 가능한 AI 진단을 신속하고 정확하게 얻을 수 있어, 임상 진료 효율과 환자 안전성이 크게 제고된다. 추가적으로 본 발명은 외부 서버나 클라우드 자원을 활용할 수 있어 확장성이 높고, 병원 간 협진이나 원격 모니터링 등 다양한 의료 시나리오에 폭넓게 적용 가능하다.]

US20260088173.title: EVALUATING FAITHFULNESS OF EXPLAINABLE AI FOR MEDICAL DECISION MAKING
US20260088173.abstract: Methods and systems include fine-tuning a classifier while masking part of a training dataset to cause a distribution of the classifier to match a distribution of an explainer model. A performance of the explainer model is determined using the fine-tuned classifier to ensure that the explainer has an above-threshold fidelity. A downstream task is performed using the classifier and the explainer model.

WO2026059831.title: PRÉDICTION DE SÉRIE CHRONOLOGIQUE MULTIMODALE EXPLICABLE POUR LA PRISE DE DÉCISION MÉDICALE
WO2026059831.abstract: Methods and systems include inferring (304) a first prediction and an explanation based on a time series input and a text input using a multi-modal prototype-based encoder. A second prediction is inferred (306) based on the text input and the explanation using a large language model. The first prediction and the second prediction are fused (308) to generate a fused prediction. A reflection is generated (309) based on the fused prediction, the second prediction, and the text input. The text input is refined (309) based on the reflection.

WO2024235686.abstract: A method for clinical decision support is described. The method comprises the steps of obtaining radiology examination data, obtaining clinical information data, determining, by a diagnosis module, at least one object of interest in the clinical information data, and determining, by an interpretability module, at least one region of interest in the radiology examination data. Furthermore, the method maps the clinical information data to the radiology examination data, transmits the result to at least one node in a healthcare network. Clinical feedback from the at least one node in the healthcare network can be obtained, and the clinical report comprising the clinical feedback transmitted and displayed.

US2023297399.title: Methods and systems for generating recommendations based on explainable decision trees for users of a software application
US2023297399.abstract: [0000]    Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for training decision trees representing users of a software application. An example method generally includes generating, from a transaction history data set for a plurality of users of a software application, a plurality of grouped data sets including transactions grouped by counterparty. A plurality of feature vectors are generated from the plurality of grouped data sets. Each feature vector generally corresponds to a user of the plurality of users and includes a plurality of features describing relationships between the user and a plurality of counterparties in a transaction history associated with the user. A decision tree is trained based on the plurality of feature vectors. The decision tree generally includes a plurality of paths terminating in a similar or different classification, and the plurality of paths distinguishes a user associated with the decision tree from other users of the software application.

US20250326474.abstract: A swimmer emergency alerting, tracking, rescue assistance, and rip current mapping system includes a stand and a life preserver that is removably mounted to the stand. The stand includes a solar panel or other charger, and the life preserver includes a battery receiving power from the charger and a sensor that is driven by the battery, such as to detect a location of the life preserver. The stand and the life preservers may wirelessly communicate with another device, such as a user device, to provide information on a status of the stand and the life preserver. A drone may fly from the stand and collect images of a shore, and the drone may process the images to identify a rip current. The drone may use data from a watercraft identifying rip current to train the processing of the images.

US20250029516.abstract: A simulator apparatus has a vessel configured to provide a predefined fluid level and having a contoured bottom surface between a beach end wall and an opposing deep end wall, and between first and second side walls. The bottom surface defines a shoreline boundary at the fluid level between the first and second side walls, a beach shoreline region above the fluid level, an underwater region, extending from the shoreline boundary toward the deep end wall, with a shallow bleach floor region. First and second ridged features define corresponding shoal regions between the ridged features and the shoreline boundary. A gap between the first and second ridged features, provides a back channel that redirects fluid toward the deep end wall. One or more fluid outlets direct fluid toward the first and second ridged features of the bottom surface, forming a simulated rip current.

CN110706455.title: Rip current prediction and alarm device
CN110706455.abstract: A rip current prediction and alarm device belongs to the field of ocean safety early warning, and comprises a fixing plate and a wind power generation device; wherein the wind power generation devicecomprises a wind wheel and a tower, the wind wheel is arranged at the top of the tower; the bottom of the tower is fixed on the fixing plate; the tower is provided with a first current meter; a loudspeaker and a data processing and control module are arranged over the fixing plate; a fixing device and a paint box are arranged under the fixing plate; and the data processing and control module is connected with the loudspeaker, the first current meter and the paint box separately through lines. The rip current prediction and alarm device of the invention is sensitive in measurement, convenient in use, and capable of timely discovering the occurrence of a rip current and giving warning, in addition, the rip current prediction and alarm device has a good warning effect by adopting various modes such as red pigment indication and loudspeaker broadcast, so as to guide a swimmer to escape in time and guide a lifeguard to perform rescue in time.

US10449433.title: Wave Energy and Rip Current Control System for Surf Pools
US10449433.abstract: The invention relates to a Surf Pool wherein a portion of the beach is provided with a wave catch basin. With the wave catch basin extending along the length of the beach, the wave catch basin will allow water to go over an infinity edge and settle in the wave catch basin, wherein wave energy backflows are eliminated and rip currents are avoided. With the wave catch basin extending along the beach side of the surf pool, the water that is collected in the wave catch basin and by pumping water out of pipe fittings or creating positive suction into pipe fittings, alters the flow of the rip current, thereby altering the wave formation characteristics. As the rip currents enter the rip current flow channels on both sides of the surfing reef, water can be suctioned down through return pipes or pumped in any direction along the surf pool bottom to stop the rip currents in the rip current flow channels, which helps the breaking waves from becoming distorted as they break.

CN110185017.title: Mobile platform for piling in rip current and supporting propulsion positioning device thereof
CN110185017.abstract: The invention discloses a mobile platform for piling in a rip current and a supporting propulsion positioning device thereof. The mobile platform comprises an insertion pile composed of a suspension arm, an operation platform, an upper platform, a lifting system and the like, an operating system for installing a pile driver, a pile guiding positioning system composed of a slide rail, a pile guideframe, guide rollers and the like and the platform propulsion positioning device composed of a bracket, a push rod, guide wheels, pulleys, a load cable and the like. Due to the special design of the slide rail and the bracket, it is convenient to install the bracket, easy one-man operation can be realized, and an original anti-rolling device is eliminated. Since the platforms are mounted on the outer side of the slide rail, the operation is safe and smooth. Due to the installation of the platform propulsion positioning device, the construction speed is increased and the labor intensity is reduced.

CN109797702.title: Pearl spring model based on rip current cause of pressure-bearing aquifer
CN109797702.abstract: The invention discloses a pearl spring simulation and demonstration experimental device formed by a discharge point of a pressure-bearing aquifer due to a rip current effect. The pearl spring simulation and demonstration experimental device comprises an overflow tank capable of controlling height and water flow, a water flow movement and bubble generation device and a pearl spring phenomenon observation device. When the device is used, the water flow speed and the bubble generation condition can be controlled by adjusting the water quantity and the height of the overflow tank capable of controlling the height and the water flow. The water flow movement and bubble generating device can be filled with coarse sand to simulate the medium of the aquifer, chemical change of the aquifer can be simulated between pulling type chemical reactions, and an air injector can ensure sufficient air in water to generate bubbles conveniently. Finally, a pearl spring phenomenon can be observed in the pearl spring phenomenon observation device. A production mode of the pearl spring in practice is simulated, and the formation process of the pearl spring can be restored and demonstrated well.

CN109035708.title: Rip current warning device
CN109035708.abstract: The invention provides a rip current warning device, composed of vertical posts, a cross beam, a cross beam spindle hole, a top beam, a first rotation shaft hole, an impeller, an impeller shell, a spindle hole, a spindle, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a first rotation shaft, a heavy hammer, a swing rod, a warning board and a second rotation shaft. When rip current occurs, in a rip current area, the impeller drives the warning board to carry out large-angle tilt under the effect of the rip current, in an adjacent non-rip current area, the warning board is basically vertical and stable, and after tourists in the rip current area observe that the warning board carries out the large-angle tilt at close distance, the tourists can swim out of the rip current area rapidly along a direction (vertical to a rip current direction) pointed by the large-angle tilt of the warning board and can swim to the non-rip current area; after the tourists in the non-rip current area observe that the warning board carries out the large-angle tilt, the tourists can go ashore rapidly; and lifeguards stop the tourists on the shore from entering the rip current area and rescue the tourists in the rip current area rapidly. The device is very important for the tourists to avoid risk and carry out self rescue and is very import for the lifeguards to carry out rescue.

CN105389468.title: Rip current forecasting method
CN105389468.abstract: The present invention discloses a rip current forecasting method. The method comprises the following steps of: (1) based on a mesoscale marine weather operational forecasting system, acquiring wind fields and pressure fields of a target sea area and surrounding sea areas of the target sea area; (2) establishing a Delft3D hydrodynamic numerical model, and simulating to obtain tidal current fields of the target sea area and the surrounding sea areas of the target sea area; (3) establishing an SWAN wave spectral model, and simulating to obtain wave fields of the target sea area and the surrounding sea areas of the target sea area; (4) extracting boundary conditions from the wave fields, using the tidal current fields as background current fields, establishing an SWASH wave analysis model, and simulating to obtain a time sequence of a water particle velocity of the target sea area; and (5) accounting intensity of a rip current. In order to consider the dynamic characteristics of coupling of multiple physical mechanisms and coexistence of multiple spatial and temporal scales of the rip current, the method comprehensively utilizes various models to respectively stimulate different physical processes, considers the interactions between various models by using data exchange and coupling, and achieves real-time forecasting of the rip current of a bathing beach so as to provide references for beach rescue.

US2005271266.title: Automated rip current detection system
US2005271266.abstract: A system substitutes digitized images for human vision, in determining the presence or absence of rip tides among sea water wave patterns at a public swimming beach. CN122636917.title: Dynamic grid method based on Delaunay graph and quaternion spatial interpolation
CN122636917.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic grid generation in computational fluid mechanics, and discloses a dynamic grid method based on a Delaunay graph and quaternion spatial interpolation, which comprises the following steps: reading geometric information of an initial computational grid, and obtaining node coordinates before and after deformation; carrying out Delaunay subdivision on the boundary nodes of the object plane to generate a background Delaunay graph covering a computational domain; establishing a mapping relation between computational grid nodes and Delaunay units in combination with a relative volume coefficient and shortest path method; calculating a rotation quaternion and a translation vector of each boundary unit based on node coordinates before and after deformation of the boundary units, and performing interpolation to obtain a rotation quaternion and a translation vector of each boundary node; and performing linear interpolation on the rotation quaternion and the translation vector of the internal node, and updating the coordinates of the internal node to obtain a deformation grid. According to the method, the dynamic mesh deformation with high calculation efficiency and high mesh quality can be realized.
